# Shopping Decision Support: Systems, Skills and Agents for Verifying a Product, Finding the Best Place to Buy and Choosing the Best Version (Poland and EU)

*Deep research report: 47 items x 37 fields, state of sources 2026-10-15. 346 of 1739 field values (19.9%) carry an agent-assigned uncertainty flag and are shown with a ⚠ instead of being dropped. Prices, fees and availability drift and were seen on 2026-10-15.*

**Question.** Is there a system, skill or agent that supports shopping decisions for a buyer in Poland: verifying a product, finding the best place to buy, and choosing the best version? Reference purchase: a garden trampoline, where many makers and shops compete. **Scope.** Poland and purchases from the EU; U.S.-only features are covered only to record that they are not usable from Poland. **Time range.** Since 2025.

## 🚀 Bottom line

**There is no single system, skill or agent that verifies a product, finds the best place to buy and picks the best version for a buyer in Poland.** What exists is a set of narrow tools, most of them free, and a workflow you can assemble from them in Claude Code. The research covered 47 tools, services, studies and rules, all checked on 2026-10-15.

- **Ready-made AI shopping assistants mostly do not reach Poland.** OpenAI's own merchant page says ChatGPT shopping is live for users in the U.S.; Perplexity product cards and Instant Buy, Amazon's Alexa for Shopping, Gemini auto browse and Microsoft Copilot Checkout are U.S.-only; Klarna's markets exclude Poland. Rufus works on Amazon.de, but no assistant was confirmed on Amazon.pl. None of the assistants checks price history, delivered cost, seller identity or product safety.
- **The Polish assistants live inside their shops.** Allegro's AI Assistant (all app users since May 2026) and Asystent Ceneo (launched around 27 May 2026) cannot be driven from Claude Code, have no independent test, and sit on top of paid ranking: Ceneo's terms list paid position bidding as a default ranking factor, and the first 16 tiles of an Allegro search for "305" were all sponsored or promoted.
- **Verification is where free official sources are strongest.** EU Safety Gate (scriptable, no key), GPSR listing fields, EN 71-14 edition and GS/Certipedia lookups, the VAT white list, KRS and VIES (keyless APIs), the CERT Polska domain list and the Omnibus 30-day price can all be checked in minutes. They are best used as red-flag filters: passing them is not proof that a product or shop is good.
- **Price comparison is the part that is hardest to automate legally.** Allegro's terms (art. 10.10-10.11, from 2026-10-13) and Ceneo's terms (art. 14.7) forbid automated access, and plain HTTP requests get 403 from most Polish shops. A browser agent did load these pages in tests, so the barrier is the terms, not the technology. Use Ceneo, Skapiec and Allegro by hand for the shortlist, and automate only registers, open data and licensed sources such as SerpApi.
- **AI agents are inconsistent and steerable, so use them as hands, not as judges.** In studies, one trusted source moved an agent's pick by 90-99 points, a model update reshuffled choices, and a shopping agent leaked personal data to a phishing page in 12 of 100 runs. Keep payment manual: no agent can check out for a Polish buyer today anyway.
- **Recommended route:** build a `brain-buy` orchestrator skill (PILOT). It stops at a verified shortlist with an evidence trail saved to the vault, runs the safety gate before any price comparison, needs two independent sources for every claim that drives the verdict, and leaves the purchase to a human. See the design section below.

## Which tool answers which question

| Question | Use this | Do not rely on |
|---|---|---|
| Which models exist and how do they differ? | Stiftung Warentest 05/2025 and VKI trampoline tests (EUR 4.90 unlock), Pro-Test for appliances and electronics, Geizhals for technical specs, `/b:research` with a product template | Wirecutter and RTINGS (no EU trampolines), ChatGPT or Perplexity answers without sources |
| Is it safe and compliant? | EU Safety Gate search, the four GPSR listing fields, EN 71-14 edition claim, GS/Certipedia ID and model-code coverage, marketplace risk tier | A "TUV" or "GS" logo with no ID, lista.cert.pl absence as proof of anything |
| Which shop has the best delivered price? | Ceneo (sort by price with delivery) and Skapiec by hand, Allegro, the Google Shopping vertical via SerpApi, idealo.de as a German anchor, Keepa on Amazon.de | Default sort orders (paid), "lowest price guarantee" badges |
| Is the discount real? | The Omnibus "lowest price in the last 30 days" field, Skapiec 1-year history, Keepa on Amazon.de, a Pepper thread as a second look | Strikethrough "old prices" taken from shop feeds |
| Is the seller real? | VAT white list (NIP and bank account check), KRS, VIES, lista.cert.pl plus domain age (RDAP), TrustMate and Opineo as weak signals | UOKiK warning list (20 entries, no shop), ratings from a single platform |
| Who protects me if it goes wrong? | Statutory conformity route (2-year presumption), card payment, Allegro Ochrona Kupujących, ECC Poland for cross-border cases | PayPal for return postage (never refunded), a purchase on a company NIP invoice |
| Can an AI complete the purchase? | No. Stop at the checkout link and pay yourself | Any agentic checkout: U.S.-only, and no protocol carries BLIK, Omnibus or GPSR fields |

## Worked example: a garden trampoline

Round garden trampoline, about 3 m, with safety net, roughly EUR 200-700. Each step names the result item that supports it.

1. **Fix requirements and budget before you see prices.** Diameter, net type, weight limit, budget cap, how long it must last. This is the first stage of the `emptor` skill and protects against anchoring on whatever a shop shows first.
2. **Run the safety gate before any price comparison.**
   - *EN 71-14 edition.* Either the 2018 or the 2025 edition is acceptable; a claim of the 2014 editions is a red flag. EN 71-14:2025 is not yet cited in the EU Official Journal, so the 2018 edition remains the harmonised one.
   - *Certificate coverage.* Look up the GS or TUV ID in Certipedia and check that your exact model code is covered. Example from the research: Salta B.V. holds one certificate (S 50702520, issued 2026-07-06 against EN 71-14:2018) that covers models 5201-5209 only. Per the EN 71-14 research item, the rectangular Salta Premium Black 214 x 305 cm (model 5362) seen on Ceneo is not covered and is a different product from the round 305 cm model Stiftung Warentest tested.
   - *GPSR panel.* The listing must show the manufacturer with postal and electronic address, an EU responsible person if the maker is outside the EU, a picture with type or identifier, and warnings in Polish. A missing EU responsible person is a hard red flag.
   - *Safety Gate.* A search for "trampoline" returned 26 alerts, including a 2017 Salta alert for a different model and Exit and Berg accessories; Zipro had none, and UOKiK had no hits for "trampolina". The portal does not match barcodes or model numbers, so a local index of the weekly XML is needed for EAN matching.
   - *Marketplace tier.* Prefer an EU brand store or an EU marketplace seller you have checked; avoid non-EU or unbranded sellers on Temu, AliExpress and Shein for a safety-critical product.
3. **Read the independent test.** Stiftung Warentest (published 2025-04-22) tested 11 round spring trampolines with nets; only the Hudora Fantastic Complete Max 300 earned "sehr gut" (1.4), the Kettler Jump 305 was "mangelhaft" (poor fit, heavy rust, PAH in the mat), and the Zero Gravity Ultima 4 Black Edition was "befriedigend". The grade table costs EUR 4.90. VKI ran the same joint test on 10 models. Caveats: three of the "gut" results were reused from April 2019, several tested models were not found in Polish shops (Hudora Max 300, Exit Elegant Premium, Salta Comfort 305, Kettler Jump 305, Lidl Crivit), and Kettler now sells a "redesigned" Jump 305. For untested models, apply the CHOICE failure-mode checklist (frame deformation, low enclosure, breaking brackets).
4. **Shortlist 3-5 models by EAN or model code,** not by title. Titles are where white-label rebadges and variant mix-ups hide: Allegro lists 9,820 trampoline offers, 85.5% shipped from Poland, 1,834 of them "bez marki", and the best sellers come from Polish importer brands.
5. **Compare delivered prices across shops by hand, across ownership groups.** Ceneo is owned by the Allegro group, so Ceneo and Allegro are not independent; Skapiec (Ringier Axel Springer Polska) and an outside anchor such as Amazon.de or idealo.de add independence. Same-day sample for the Salta Premium Black 5362: Ceneo showed 9 offers from PLN 2,279.54; Skapiec showed 11 offers from PLN 2,099 at Kaufland.pl, and its "promoted offer" (Media Expert, PLN 2,399.99) was 14% above the cheapest. On Ceneo the same Funfit 312 cm model ranged from 359 to 1,260.99 PLN across offers. For bulky goods, return costs matter: the shop must state them (Art. 12(1)(10) of the Consumer Rights Act).
6. **Test whether the discount is real.** Read the 30-day lowest price on the offer, then compare with Skapiec's open 1-year history or Ceneo's 6-month history. Treat a missing or vague reference price, or a percentage not computed from it, as a red flag. A correct-looking reference is still self-declared.
7. **Check the seller before paying.** Look up the NIP in the VAT white list and confirm the bank account belongs to it (the TAK/NIE check). A fake shop can paste a real company's NIP, so also compare the shop's domain, contact details and account with the register entry. Check the domain against lista.cert.pl (125,845 active domains, about 597 added per day; two trampoline clone shops were on it) and its age in RDAP. Use TrustMate and Opineo as weak signals only: Media Expert scored 4.7 on Ceneo and 1.9-2.1 on Opineo.
8. **Pay as a consumer, by card, and keep the evidence.** Buy as a consumer rather than on a company NIP invoice (a 2026 forum case shows Allegro refused protection to a buyer treated as a non-consumer). Allegro Ochrona Kupujących pays up to 20,000 PLN per transaction but excludes carrier damage; PayPal never refunds return postage. Save listing URLs, screenshots and the checked registers into a vault note.

## Limits on automation: terms, robots.txt and legal status

*General information compiled from the result files, not legal advice.*

- **Allegro:** Regulamin art. 10.10 requires Allegro's consent to download or use its data and bans scraping for business use; art. 10.11 bans bots and data-extraction tools. The agents read this in the version in force from 2026-10-13; one agent could not tell whether the ban is new in that version or older.
- **Ceneo:** terms effective 2026-08-01, art. 14.7 bans automated access without written consent; art. 14.10 sets a contractual penalty of PLN 50,000 per breach, tied to copying or sharing content (art. 14.9) rather than to art. 14.7 directly. Ceneo's robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot and Claude-SearchBot.
- **Others:** Keepa's terms (version 2026-10-07) ban scrapers, and its API is for business use. Pepper blocks ClaudeBot, GPTBot and ChatGPT-User in robots.txt. UOKiK's site blocks ClaudeBot and GPTBot, while the EU Safety Gate portal has no such rule. Amazon blocks Claude-named agents and eBay bans buy-for-me agents from 2026-02-20 (both from secondary coverage).
- **What a browser agent can do technically:** in tests Claude in Chrome and browser-use loaded Allegro, Ceneo, Media Expert, Decathlon.pl and Amazon.pl listings without a challenge, where plain HTTP fetches got 403. These were single, low-volume probes and say nothing about behaviour at scale.
- **Practical split.** Do the Ceneo, Skapiec and Allegro comparison by hand for the shortlist. Automate only official registers and open data (Safety Gate, white list, KRS, VIES, CERT list), licensed or paid sources (SerpApi, Keepa API on Amazon.de), and pages that permit it. Do not point Apify, Bright Data or Firecrawl at Allegro or Ceneo.

## What did not hold up

19 claims from the preliminary screen or common coverage that the deep research overturned or narrowed. Where a correction contradicts an item's detail section below, the correction wins.

**1. Claimed:** Nokaut is an active Polish comparison engine.

**Actually:** Closed. The closure statement is dated 2024-12-20, the site was gone by January 2025, and nokaut.pl now redirects elsewhere.

**2. Claimed:** Geizhals has a Polish site.

**Actually:** Its Polish site (cenowarka.pl) and UK site closed on 2025-10-31; geizhals.eu offers only AT, DE and EU.

**3. Claimed:** Keepa and CamelCamelCamel cover Amazon.pl.

**Actually:** No. Keepa covers 11 marketplaces (US, UK, DE, FR, JP, CA, IT, ES, IN, MX, BR); CamelCamelCamel has no API. Keepa now also runs an official hosted MCP server (https://keepa.com/mcp, API plans from EUR 49 a month).

**4. Claimed:** There is no Apify actor for Ceneo.

**Actually:** Several exist (bovi/ceneo-price-scraper, studio-amba/ceneo-scraper and others, about USD 2-4.75 per 1,000 rows), but they breach Ceneo's terms.

**5. Claimed:** lista.cert.pl covers only phishing, so absence from it means nothing about shops.

**Actually:** It also covers fake shops (125,845 active domains, two trampoline clone shops among them). Absence is still not a trust signal, because entries drop off after 6 months.

**6. Claimed:** The UOKiK warning list helps vet online shops.

**Actually:** It has 20 entries from 2015 to April 2025, all pyramid or finance schemes, and no online shop.

**7. Claimed:** UOKiK keeps a national register of dangerous products.

**Actually:** Abolished from 2026-01-03 (Act of 7 Nov 2025). What remains is the register of non-compliant products (about 370 entries) and recall notices.

**8. Claimed:** EN 71-14:2025 is the harmonised standard.

**Actually:** It is not cited in the Official Journal. The Commission's summary list generated 2026-09-14 still cites only EN 71-14:2018.

**9. Claimed:** The Inspekcja Handlowa check covered 3,026 businesses.

**Actually:** 3,026 physical establishments, of which 1,462 had price-information errors of any kind; online shops and the 30-day rule are not counted separately.

**10. Claimed:** Allegro's AI Assistant pilot started in December 2025 and about 600k people bought with it.

**Actually:** The in-app pilot started in November 2025 (announced 2025-10-30); December 2025 was the custom GPT. The 600k figure is worded three ways (bought, active, testers) and the purchase share is unknown.

**11. Claimed:** Allegro Price Tracker & History is an Allegro product.

**Actually:** It is made by an individual developer: 149 users, no ratings, not updated since 2025-12-10. Cenowskaz is Allegro's own extension.

**12. Claimed:** Allegro Protect is the buyer-protection name.

**Actually:** Renamed back to Allegro Ochrona Kupujących on 2025-08-18.

**13. Claimed:** Google AI Mode shopping works in Poland.

**Actually:** Only the Polish-language AI Mode answers do. Price tracking, Buy for me and Let Google Call are U.S.-only.

**14. Claimed:** The Shopify Global Catalog MCP has an update_cart tool and filters reliably by ships-to country.

**Actually:** The live tool list is search_catalog, lookup_catalog and get_product; cart tools are a separate MCP. ships_to PL still returned Australian shops and cross-merchant clustering did not merge the same model.

**15. Claimed:** AliExpress is only 'under DSA proceedings'.

**Actually:** The Commission fined it EUR 550M on 2026-07-20, the largest DSA fine so far.

**16. Claimed:** ChatGPT ads launched in 30 European countries including Poland.

**Actually:** OpenAI's 2026-08-18 post names 31 markets and does not name Poland; one trade source does. Unresolved.

**17. Claimed:** Only Claude Sonnet 4 resisted manipulation in Magentic Marketplace.

**Actually:** The paper (arXiv 2510.25779) says Sonnet-4.5 showed the strongest resistance; the Microsoft blog says Sonnet-4. The headline '10-30x' speed advantage is in the abstract; the paper's own worked example is about 4.5x.

**18. Claimed:** firecrawl-shop is a MEDIUM-risk skill.

**Actually:** That is one scanner's label (Snyk). Two other audits on skills.sh passed it.

**19. Claimed:** About 71% of Polish e-commerce transactions in Q4 2025 are BLIK.

**Actually:** The figure comes from PPRO (2026-08-12), citing cashless.pl, with no period given.

## Cross-cutting findings

- **Lifecycle churn is the headline risk.** Fakespot (2025-07-01), the Firefox Review Checker (2025-06-10), ReviewMeta (offline), ChatGPT Atlas (2026-08-09), ChatGPT Instant Checkout (scaled back March 2026), Klarna's open-standard repository (archived 2026-08-05) and Nokaut all stopped or shrank within about 18 months. A tool chain needs a verified-on date and a re-check schedule.
- **Agentic checkout is U.S.-only; Polish payment rails are pilots.** Mastercard Agent Pay tests with mBank, Pekao and UniCredit (2026-05-25), Visa live transactions with 31 European issuers including mBank and PKO BP (2026-07-02) and one BLIK restock purchase of PLN 19.99 (2026-09-09). Stripe lists Poland for Shared Payment Tokens in public preview, so the payment layer is technically ready, but no consumer agent offers checkout to Polish buyers. Liability for a wrong purchase within a valid mandate is unresolved under PSD2.
- **Ceneo and Allegro are the same group, so they are not independent price checks.** Ceneo.pl is a subsidiary of Allegro.eu S.A., which also owns Allegro.pl; per the Ceneo item, Allegro buys sponsored ads shown on Ceneo for selected sellers (seller notice effective 2025-07-01, with a price-parity condition), and Ceneo accounts accept Allegro logins. Skapiec belongs to Ringier Axel Springer Polska (Onet's owner) and takes its reviews from sister site Opineo. Cross-check across both groups, and add idealo.de or Amazon.de as an outside anchor.
- **Almost every comparison source is paid by the shops.** Ceneo's default order is paid; two of six Skapiec ranking factors are paid; Allegro's first 16 tiles in one search were paid; Pepper sells promoted slots and is run by an affiliate group; Okazje.info ranking is affected by seller fees; TrustMate and Opineo are shop-funded. Ratings diverge across platforms: Media Expert scored 4.7 on Ceneo, 3.4 on Trustpilot and 1.9-2.1 on Opineo.
- **Price-history coverage is thin.** Allegro has no price-history chart (only a 30-day reference on discounted offers); Ceneo shows a 6-month trend across shops after login; Skapiec shows up to 1 year without login; Keepa and CamelCamelCamel skip Amazon.pl.
- **AI shopping answers are inconsistent.** Product.ai (vendor study, September 2026) found a fact changing in at least 2 of 5 runs for 86% of 217 evaluable questions and 15% of 913 checkable prices wrong; Core dna (October 2026) found 15 of 24 prices wrong and 14 of 20 answers changing on a second ask. Neither tested the ChatGPT shopping-research mode specifically, and Google objected that Product.ai used its developer API.
- **Agents can be steered.** ACES showed model updates reshuffling picks (Fitbit Inspire share 45% to 77% between two Claude versions) and a platform badge lifting a product from 10% to 20-43% of picks; Wharton (reported 2026-08-27) found one Wirecutter source swinging a pick by 90-99 points; F-Secure (July 2026) found a Claude Haiku shopping agent leaking personal data in 12 of 100 runs; Zenity bypassed Atlas's soft confirmation and used Amazon Rufus to place an order.
- **Cashback is a tie-breaker, not a strategy.** On a 1,800 PLN trampoline, LetyShops at Decathlon returns about 33 PLN after 60-90 days and loses it on return; a 5% price gap between shops is worth about 90 PLN.
- **Independent evidence is thin.** No independent hands-on test exists for Asystent Ceneo or the Allegro assistant, none of the agent-reliability studies tested Polish shops, and several facts come from vendor blogs or sponsored articles (flagged inside the items).
- **Future rules help later, not now.** The Digital Fairness Act had not been proposed on 2026-10-15; the toy digital product passport applies from 2030, and treating trampolines as toys rests on EN 71-14 being a toy standard.

## Should the vault build a buying skill

**Recommendation: build it as a PILOT and test it on the trampoline.** No existing system, assistant or community skill covers Polish shops, EU safety checks, Omnibus and seller registers together, while every needed component works from Poland for free or a few euros.

**Proposed shape (from the design item).** A `brain-buy` orchestrator skill with a `/b:buy` command, stages S0-S8, reusing `/b:research` with a product-specific `fields.yaml` for specs, tests and safety, browser-use logged out for page reads (Claude in Chrome only when your own session is needed), and three small scripts: a Safety Gate query, a seller check (VAT white list, KRS, VIES, CERT list, RDAP) and Omnibus parsing. The pipeline is: requirements, shortlist (specs, variant and EAN mapping), independent tests and safety, delivered cost with price history and Omnibus, seller identity and buyer-protection path, verdict with an evidence trail.

**Hard limits for the skill**
- Safety and GPSR checks run before any price comparison.
- Every claim that drives the verdict needs two independent sources.
- No Apify or Firecrawl on Allegro, Ceneo or Skapiec.
- Raw evidence stays under `content/_raw/`; only a compiled note with conclusions is published, because the vault deploys to a public site and the Ceneo assistant's output licence is personal use only.
- The skill stops before payment; a human buys.

**Nine design rules from the bias studies (ACES, Wharton, Product.ai)**
1. Build the candidate set from listings with EAN or model codes.
2. Shuffle candidate order and rerun at least 3 times, reporting how often the runs agree.
3. List every source in order, then rerun without the dominant one.
4. Strip badges and sponsored labels from the inputs.
5. Take prices only from live pages, with timestamps.
6. Run without chat memory and write preferences as explicit criteria.
7. Record the model version and retest when it changes.
8. Stop before payment for human confirmation and a hard cap.
9. Treat page text as data, not instructions.

**Six guardrails from the manipulation studies**
1. A hard confirmation before payment, enforced in code: the agent stops at the cart.
2. No saved cards, passwords or autofill in the agent's browser profile.
3. If delegation is ever used, a spending mandate scoped to one merchant and one amount (an AP2 closed payment mandate or an ACP scoped token).
4. A seller check outside the model before checkout, using the registries and lists above.
5. List at least N offers before shortlisting, to counter first-proposal bias.
6. An action log the human reviews.

**Templates.** Fork `emptor` (MIT) for needs elicitation, locked budget before prices, four source-trust tiers, finalists verified before ranking, a five-signal review check that marks unobservable signals as "unchecked", and a weight-sensitivity brief with a JSONL journal. Reuse only the ideas of the infranodus `skill-shopping` (no licence): same-lineup near-equivalents, a 20-30% stretch, and any competitor named in two or more independent reviews.

**Estimates (not measured):** build about 12-18 hours; one run about EUR 0-10 in cash plus roughly 2-3.5M tokens. The skill can live in this vault only: the template drift check compares a fixed list of shared skills and would not flag a brain-only skill.

## Open conflicts and unverified points

- **Google Shopping in Poland, unresolved.** The Google Shopping item says free multi-shop comparison on google.pl is largely gone after the September 2026 DMA changes and that price history is not confirmed for Poland. The SerpApi item's browser test on 2026-10-15 saw the Shopping vertical (udm=28) still showing 20+ Polish sellers, a "Najtaniej (30 dni)" badge and a 12-month "Historia cen" table. Treat the EEA removal as partial and re-test before relying on either.
- **Which Salta is which.** The Ceneo and Skapiec price sample used a rectangular Salta Premium Black 5362; per the EN 71-14 item, Stiftung Warentest tested a round 305 cm Salta and the certificate does not cover 5362. Only the EN 71-14 agent made this claim.
- **Dates and figures that differ by source:** the Amazon v. Perplexity injunction (reported 2026-03-06 versus about 2026-03-09), the Perplexity free-tier start, whether Poland is among the ChatGPT ad markets, whether Gemini in Chrome launched in Poland (one site says yes, two say no), whether Alexa for Shopping is available outside the U.S., and whether BLIK has a chargeback-like dispute (consumer guides say no, PPRO documentation describes 13-month disputes).
- **Not tested hands-on:** Asystent Ceneo, the Allegro AI Assistant and its ChatGPT app, ChatGPT shopping research from Poland, SerpApi's real output for Poland (no API key was available), Cenowskaz's affiliate parameters, and the PriceRoo, Histozon and Hagglezon extensions on an Amazon.pl product.
- **Unconfirmed:** whether Rufus or Alexa for Shopping exists on Amazon.pl, the parent company above Ringier Axel Springer Polska (which runs Skapiec and Opineo), a Ceneo app in ChatGPT (none found), Discount Bandit's licence (none found), and the hosted operator of changedetection.io.
- **Vendor-sourced figures** (user counts, coverage claims, accuracy claims) are marked inside the items. Several press items were sponsored (Antyweb on Asystent Ceneo, CHIP on Allegro's assistant) and are flagged there.

## Method and how to read the detail

Preliminary framework from model knowledge (30 candidates), a web-search supplement (since 2025, Poland plus EU purchases) that grew it to 47 items in nine groups, then one deep-research agent per three items, run in four batches. Each agent filled 37 fields per item (identity, capabilities, data and integration, trust and bias, fit for the user, assessment) and checked primary sources on 2026-10-15; every file was validated for full field coverage. Where an agent could not open a page (many were 403 or blocked), the field cites search-result summaries and says so.

**How uncertainty is shown.** Unlike the standard report, fields marked uncertain by the agents are kept in the item detail and flagged with the warning sign so confirmed parts are not lost; inline "(unverified ...)" marks the specific claim. A warning sign before a field name means the agent listed the whole field as uncertain.

## A. Price comparison, price history and marketplaces

### Ceneo

**Verdict:** USE NOW (manual only) · **Cost:** Free; account needed for price history · **Verified:** 2026-10-15 · 9 field(s) flagged ⚠

#### identity

**basics**

Ceneo.pl is the largest Polish price comparison engine. It combines a product catalogue, offer comparison across Polish online shops, user and purchase-verified reviews ('Zaufane Opinie'), shop ratings and awards ('Ranking Zaufanych Sklepow' / 'Sklep Roku'), and its own checkout marketplace 'Kup Teraz' (multi-shop cart, one payment via PayU). Also runs Taniomania.pl search and Ceneolokalnie (local pick-up listings), plus web, Android (pl.ceneo) and iOS (id395672526) apps. Role type: comparison engine with a marketplace layer. Its AI layer (Asystent Ceneo, ZapytAI, AI review summaries) is covered in the separate item 'Asystent Ceneo'.

**vendor and ownership**

Operator: Ceneo.pl sp. z o.o., ul. Legnicka 48 A, 54-202 Wroclaw, KRS 0000634928, NIP 525-26-74-781, share capital PLN 5,000,000 (terms, section 2.1). Parent: Allegro.eu S.A. (Luxembourg, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange), which also owns the Allegro.pl marketplace. Allegro's investor relations describe Ceneo.pl as an Allegro-group subsidiary, e.g. in the release on the Google lawsuit. Founded 2005 (site footer '2005-2026'; oldest review dated 27 June 2005). Bias-relevant ties: (1) same group as Allegro, the largest competing PL marketplace; (2) Allegro buys sponsored ads shown on Ceneo for selected Allegro sellers (Allegro seller notice dated 16-06-2025, effective 2025-07-01, with a price-parity condition); (3) Ceneo accounts can log in with Allegro credentials. Staff: 198 employees (vendor-claimed, Feb 2025, in a paid product-placement article).

**lifecycle status**

Live and actively developed. Launched 2005. Latest changes found: new terms effective 2026-08-01 (PDF created 2026-07-22) that add Annex 5 'Asystent AI'; Asystent Ceneo launched around 27 May 2026; 'Sklep Roku 2026' (16th edition) running, results not yet published on 2026-10-15. Verified 2026-10-15 by opening ceneo.pl category and product pages and the current terms PDF (primary source: shops.ceneo.pl/documents/VersionedDocuments/Current/CeneoUserServiceAgreement). Several secondary sources describing features (Spider's Web 2022, Antyweb Jan 2024) are older than six months; their claims were re-checked on live pages where possible.

**⚠ cost model**

Free for consumers, no subscription. A free account (email, or Google, Facebook or Allegro login) is required for price history and account features. Merchants pay: cost per click ('Stawka za Klik'), paid position auctions ('licytowanie pozycji'), a paid 'strefa sklepu' (shop zone), prepaid budgets, and Kup Teraz sales fees (⚠ *(unverified)* rate not published on pages opened). The Zaufane Opinie programme is free for shops. Seen 2026-10-15, PLN, Poland.

**feature geo matrix**

- **Poland**: All features available: offer comparison across PL shops, 6-month price history (login), target-price alerts, purchase-verified reviews, shop ratings, Kup Teraz checkout (PayU) with the Program Ochrony Kupujacych (POK) buyer protection, Asystent Ceneo, mobile app with barcode and photo search (App Store listing).
- **EU outside Poland**: The site is reachable, but it indexes Polish shops only. Terms 3.17 require all content to be in Polish. There is no Amazon.de or idealo-style EU comparison. Delivery abroad depends on each shop.
- **US**: N/A. No US service.
- **language**: Interface and catalogue in Polish only. Asystent Ceneo answers in the language of the question (vendor-claimed, see separate item).
- **US only or agentic features**: No agentic checkout or buy-for-me. The AI assistant can add items to the Kup Teraz cart on an explicit user command only (terms Annex 5, sections 3.1 and 4.1).

#### capabilities

**spec and variant comparison**

Partial. Ceneo keeps a product catalogue with category attributes and filters. For trampolines: price, brand, type, size, trampoline diameter, maximum user weight, age. Product pages list structured specs; e.g. Zipro Jumpin 10FT (card 90991500) shows frame 312 cm, mat 250 cm, net height 180 cm, inner net, max user 150 kg, packaging weights. Terms 3.9 say one catalogue card can describe several variants, the catalogue is non-binding, and the shop's offer text prevails. Merchant feeds must carry EAN and producer code (Base.com integration docs), so matching is EAN-led. Observed failures on 2026-10-15: the same Salta Premium Black 214x305 cm (5362) is split across at least two cards (98507173 with 9 offers and 199567686 with fewer offers), so the cheapest offer can sit on a duplicate card. Card 90991500 mixes the names 'Jumpin' and 'Jump Pro'. No mapping of white-label or OEM rebadges and no logic for near-equivalent models beyond 'similar products' blocks was found. Terms 14.5 admit that catalogue data may be generated or filled in with AI and may be wrong.

**⚠ price comparison and pl coverage**

Yes, this is the core function. It covers only shops that list on Ceneo (feed plus CPC or Kup Teraz); it is not a whole-market crawl. Vendor-claimed scale (Feb 2025 product-placement article): 39,000 registered shops, 51,000 producers, 349.5 million offers and 92.2 million products integrated over 20 years. Older secondary figure: 18,000 shops and 23 million offers (H1 2020). Traffic: about 32.3 million visits per month (SimilarWeb, April 2025, cited by seigi.eu); 70 million visits per month is a vendor claim. Observed 2026-10-15: the Trampoliny category lists 658 products. Offers on tested cards came from empik.com, morele.net, mediaexpert.pl, avans.pl, electro.pl, sferis.pl, net-s.pl and fitshop.pl, plus Kup Teraz sellers (Akces-Markt, MultiZakupy, PRO-TOPP). No Allegro or Amazon offers appeared on the tested cards. ⚠ *(unverified)* Base.com docs mention 'Allegro-redirect offers' on Ceneo, so some Allegro offers may appear elsewhere. Decathlon.pl and x-kom were not verified. No EU shops (Amazon.de) at all. Same-day cross-check on Salta Premium Black 5362: Ceneo showed 9 offers from PLN 2,279.54 (net-s.pl), while Skapiec showed 11 offers from PLN 2,099.00 (Kaufland.pl). Ceneo is not always the cheapest view.

**⚠ price history and omnibus**

Price history: product pages carry 'Historia cen - trend cenowy' with a link to 'Zobacz ceny z 6 miesiecy'. The text 'Historia cen dostepna jest po zalogowaniu sie' confirms the chart needs a login (verified on cards 90991500 and 98507173, 2026-10-15). Length: 6 months, with no 3- or 12-month option seen. Scope: one product-level trend of the lowest offer price, not per-shop history (Antyweb description). ⚠ *(unverified)* Picodi (Apr 2026) says the chart updates every 5 days. Omnibus: the offer lists on product pages do not show each shop's lowest price from the 30 days before a promotion; none was seen on 2 product pages, even beside a shop banner reading 'Jesienne okazje do -40%'. Ceneo's own 'Superceny' deal pages work out the discount % against 'the lowest offer price of this product in shops in the last 30 days' ('Najnizsza cena z 30 dni w serwisie'). That reference is a 30-day low across shops for the whole service, stricter than the per-shop Omnibus rule. There is no automatic flag for shops whose promotions break Omnibus. To tell a real discount from a fake one, a logged-in user compares the 6-month trend and the Superceny 30-day reference by hand.

**total landed cost**

Partial. Each offer shows its delivery cost (e.g. 'Wysylka od 15,00 zl' at empik; 'od 109,00 zl' and 'od 250,00 zl' on the bulky Salta trampoline) and the ship-by time. Offers can be sorted by 'ceny z dostawa: najnizszej' (lowest price including delivery). Badges show free delivery (Cfree coupons) and instalments ('Raty 10x0%'). Not computed: payment fees, assembly, return shipping and return fees, and cross-border warranty. For a 25-50 kg trampoline, delivery adds roughly PLN 15 to 250 per offer, so use the delivery-inclusive sort.

**review and seller verification**

Partial. Two review types (terms 5.3). Opinie Zwykle are not verified by purchase. Zaufane Opinie are purchase-verified through a post-purchase survey and marked with a green shield. A shop review can be left up to 180 days after purchase, a product review up to 1 year. Shops in the Zaufane Opinie programme may switch off non-verified reviews. Moderation (terms 5.6) removes self-reviews by sellers, reviews from temporary e-mail addresses, automated or copied reviews, and duplicates per order. A seller may contact a reviewer within 30 days. If the reviewer does not reply within 30 days, the review is hidden but still counted in the shop's statistics (terms 5.8, the post-2021 UOKiK fix). Shop signals: X/5 rating with a count, plus badges 'Zaufane Opinie', 'Skuteczny sprzedawca', 'Sklep Roku 2026', 'Solidny Sprzedawca' and 'Program Ochrony Kupujacych'. 'Ranking Zaufanych Sklepow' uses the last year of reviews in 13 categories; weights are not disclosed. Product pages also carry an AI summary of the 'most useful' reviews ('CeneoAI'). Seller identity: no CEIDG, KRS, VAT white list or VIES data is shown, and terms 3.6 exclude Ceneo's liability for seller solvency and performance. Ceneo cannot prove: that a highly rated shop is legitimate today (domain takeovers keep old reviews, e.g. Skyteel.pl 2020), that its ratings agree with other platforms (Media Expert 4.7/5 from 3,430 reviews on Ceneo vs 2.1/5 from 14,741 on Opineo, same day), or that non-verified reviews are authentic.

**safety and compliance checks**

None. No Safety Gate or UOKiK register lookups, no structured GPSR fields (manufacturer, EU responsible person, Polish warnings) on the trampoline pages checked, no EN 71-14 version, and no certificate verification. Terms 3.6(d): Ceneo is not liable for the quality, safety or legality of goods or the accuracy of seller descriptions. Nothing here can run automatically.

**independent test coverage**

N/A as a source: Ceneo does not surface Stiftung Warentest, VKI, Which?, CHOICE or RTINGS results. It offers user reviews, AI review summaries, popularity 'rankingi' and editorial guides. For trampolines no lab-test data is shown.

**⚠ alerts and monitoring**

Price alerts: the user enters a target price and is told when it is reached ('Wpisz swoja cene - damy znac', info.ceneo.pl/historia-cen). Favourites trigger notices of a 'significant price drop'. Terms 3.3 also list notifications of a price change in a shop and of new shop offers. Channel: e-mail and the mobile app (⚠ *(unverified)* push not confirmed in a primary source). How often prices are checked is not published. Alerts only watch Ceneo-listed offers, not arbitrary Polish shop pages. ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether alerts need an account; the notification settings sit in the account per the terms.

**purchase automation and guardrails**

Kup Teraz is a native checkout across several shops with one payment. PayU S.A. is the payment operator (licensed by the KNF), and the seller of record is each shop; Ceneo is not a party to the sale (terms 3.5). Asystent AI can add products to the Kup Teraz cart only on an explicit user command and does not make purchase decisions (Annex 5, sections 4.1 and 4.3). Adding to the cart does not form a contract. No autonomous buying, agent payment API, spending caps or mandates exist. A human completes checkout. Errors and disputes: complaints about Ceneo's own services are answered within 14 days (terms 12.4); complaints about goods go to the seller.

**after sales and resale**

Kup Teraz order history and status sit in 'Moje zamowienia' and the AI assistant. A separate 'Akcesoria do trampolin' category exists, but the product card does not map spare parts (nets, pads, springs). No service network, warranty-handling aid, resale value or used-market link (OLX, Allegro Lokalnie, Vinted). Ceneolokalnie covers local pick-up only.

#### data and integration

**⚠ data sources and freshness**

Merchant XML feeds (one per shop account). Integrator docs say Ceneo pulls feeds 'every few hours', and Base.com says a new product can take up to 8 hours to appear. Kup Teraz offers come through the Ceneo panel or integrators. The catalogue is maintained by Ceneo and partly generated or filled in with AI (terms 14.5). Reviews are user-supplied. Each offer links out to the shop ('Idz do sklepu'); Ceneo keeps no snapshot. Terms 3.4 and 3.8 tell the user to verify with the shop, whose description prevails. Reported lags and mismatches: Pepper.pl users describe offer links pointing to the wrong product (⚠ *(unverified)* anecdotal).

**⚠ api mcp skill access**

Grade: partial for research and none for official consumer access. (1) Official consumer API: none public. (2) Partner Program API for affiliate publishers: a REST/OData 'PartnerService' with OAuth 2.0 client credentials. A GetProducts call returns lowest and highest price, shop count, rating and product URL; some categories are restricted, and a working website is needed for a test key. ⚠ *(unverified)* This is documented only by a third-party guide (itechguides) and was not confirmed on a Ceneo developer page. (3) A Business API exists for shops and producers (offers, orders), for merchants only. (4) MCP: no official or community Ceneo MCP server was found ('gh search repos ceneo mcp' returned 0 results on 2026-10-15). (5) Apify community actors, which can be exposed through Apify's hosted MCP server (mcp.apify.com, OAuth or bearer token): bovi/ceneo-price-scraper (from USD 4.75 per 1,000 products; product-level lowest price only, first results page only, Polish residential proxy built in, 16 users); studio-amba/ceneo-scraper (from USD 2.00 per 1,000 results, routed through Bright Data Web Unlocker, 22 users); also trev0n/ceneo-scraper, noahadler/ceneo-products and reviewscraper/ceneo-pl-product-reviews-scraper. All are unaudited and none returns per-shop offer tables plus price history together. (6) GitHub: about 30 small scrapers (0-3 stars), e.g. kubo550/ceneo-scraper (reviews), JakPietrzyk/ceneo-price-notifier (updated 2025-12-30) and bogdal/price-tracker (2020). Skill: mits-pl/wove ships an 'online-order' SKILL.md that lists Ceneo as a source (community, not reviewed). (7) Browser agent or WebFetch: pages fetched fine on 2026-10-15, but terms 14.7 ban automated access without Ceneo's written consent. robots.txt disallows search URLs (';szukaj') and blocks ClaudeBot and Claude-SearchBot completely; GPTBot is not listed. (8) Fallback: manual browsing, then paste figures and a screenshot into the vault. Setup effort: manual takes zero setup; an Apify actor takes about 15 minutes (token plus MCP config) but carries the terms-of-service risk below.

**protocol support**

None found: no ACP, UCP, AP2, Klarna APP, Visa Trusted Agent Protocol or Web Bot Auth, and not on Shopify. No Ceneo app in ChatGPT was found (search on 2026-10-15). It is a closed, first-party ecosystem, so it will not be reachable from future agent-commerce protocols unless Ceneo opts in.

**open source and licence**

closed

**account linking and data access**

Browsing works without an account. An account (e-mail and password, or Google, Facebook or Allegro login, terms 4.1) is needed for price history, alerts, assistant history and Kup Teraz order tracking. Allegro login shares the Allegro ID, and for Allegro business accounts also company name, NIP and address (privacy notice, Annex 3). Kup Teraz payment details go to PayU, not to Ceneo or Claude. The cookie banner lists 130 partners (126 IAB TCF vendors) with ad-profiling purposes; decline the non-essential ones. Data controller: Ceneo.pl sp. z o.o. The GDPR notice is in terms Annex 3. Nothing requires handing payment credentials to an agent.

**automation legal risk**

High for automated or bulk use, low for manual personal use. Terms 14.4: Ceneo content is a legally protected database, re-use requires consent, and Ceneo reserves civil and criminal steps. Terms 14.7-14.8: automated access (bots, crawlers) is forbidden without written consent. Terms 14.9-14.10: copying, distributing or reproducing any Ceneo data carries a contractual penalty of PLN 50,000 per violation, cumulative, plus further damages. The EU sui generis database right (Directive 96/9/EC; Polish database protection act) adds statutory exposure. Anti-bot: Apify actor pages call Ceneo a 'protected target' needing residential proxies. robots.txt blocks Anthropic's crawlers. Risk of account bans when scraping while logged in. Vault note: the buyer's vault publishes to a public website, so reproducing Ceneo offer tables in published notes could itself fall under terms 14.9. Keep raw snapshots in the non-published _raw area and publish only short summaries.

#### trust and bias

**monetization and bias vector**

Paid factors enter both default orderings. Default product order on category pages, 'Rekomendowane' (terms 3.18): click-outs to shops, attribute completeness, paid position bidding, CPC, the Zaufane Opinie badge and a paid 'strefa sklepu'. The category page states that bold product names are ordered by a paid auction among Ceneo partners. Default offer order on product pages, 'Najlepsze' (terms 3.19): price relative to rivals, CPC, stock, availability in Kup Teraz, position bidding, shop rating and the Zaufane Opinie badge. The product page says 'Pozycje ofert zostaly oplacone' (offer positions are paid) and that an auction decides the order. Search results are also shaped by paid highlighting (terms 3.20b). Other vectors: 'Reklama' ad blocks inside listings; Allegro-paid ads (from 2025-07-01); Kup Teraz availability as a ranking factor, which favours Ceneo's own marketplace; group ownership by Allegro.eu; an affiliate programme paying publishers. Specific paid items seen on 2026-10-15: bold product names on category and search pages (e.g. the first 'Salta Premium Black Edition 305 cm' result was bold, i.e. paid) and the 'Wybrane oferty' block on product pages.

**⚠ ranking transparency**

Partial. Ranking factors are listed in terms 3.18-3.20 without weights. On-page disclosures exist: bold names are paid; 'Pozycje ofert zostaly oplacone. O kolejnosci prezentacji ofert decyduje mechanizm licytacji'; the 'Wybrane oferty' tooltip says the order depends on a paid partner auction. Users can switch to sorts by price, price including delivery, fastest shipping or shop rating. No single shop can be excluded (⚠ *(unverified)* a 'Filtry' panel exists but no shop-exclusion filter was seen). The help centre describes 'Oferty wybrane przez Ceneo' as chosen on ratings, availability, price and badge, without mentioning payment, which conflicts with the on-page disclosure.

**run to run consistency**

N/A for listings (not an AI tool). Price-sorted lists are deterministic at a point in time. Default 'Rekomendowane' and 'Najlepsze' orders can change between visits as auction bids and CPC change. For the AI layer see the 'Asystent Ceneo' item.

**manipulation and injection resistance**

Not an LLM surface (see 'Asystent Ceneo' for prompt-injection exposure). Documented abuse: Aleshop.pl (2019) built up a Ceneo rating, then took orders it never fulfilled; Skyteel.pl (2020) was a taken-over old domain that still showed 2017 reviews; Bezprawnik (Dec 2021) criticised doubtful electronics sellers reaching Ceneo through marketplaces, including one with a NIP that was hard to verify and a bank account not on the VAT white list. Safeguards: purchase-verified Zaufane Opinie, moderation rules against seller self-reviews and automated reviews, POK protection for Kup Teraz orders. UOKiK fined review-selling firms (Opinie.pro sold reviews posted on Ceneo among other sites). No public data on how fast fake shops are removed.

**known failures**

(1) Duplicate product cards split offers (Salta 5362 on at least two cards). (2) Catalogue naming and spec inconsistencies (Jumpin vs Jump Pro; AI-filled catalogue data admitted in terms 14.5). (3) Price history is behind a login, limited to 6 months, and shows one aggregate lowest-price trend without per-shop history. (4) The default sort is paid-influenced, so a casual user sees an auction order, not the cheapest offer. (5) Coverage gaps: no Allegro or Amazon offers on tested cards; Skapiec found a PLN 180 cheaper offer for the same model on the same day. (6) Fake or doubtful shops historically gained good ratings (2019-2021 cases). (7) Offer links occasionally point to the wrong product (Pepper user reports, anecdotal). (8) No safety or compliance data. (9) Shop ratings diverge strongly from other platforms (Media Expert, ELECTRO.pl). (10) Hostile to automation: terms ban, ClaudeBot blocked in robots.txt.

**⚠ regulatory enforcement history**

UOKiK: soft intervention ('wystapienie miekkie') in April 2021 against Ceneo and Opineo over hiding negative reviews when a reviewer did not answer a seller's message. Both platforms changed their rules; Ceneo's current terms keep hidden reviews in shop statistics. No fine. No other UOKiK, DSA or court decision against Ceneo was found. As claimant: the Warsaw Regional Court granted Ceneo an interim injunction against Google's self-preferencing (14 Mar 2024, PLN 50,000 per day penalty; a later PLN 8 m penalty was reported by secondary sources ⚠ *(unverified)*). Ceneo also filed a PLN 2.331 bn damages suit on 23 Dec 2024 against Google Ireland, Google LLC and Alphabet, building on the EC Google Shopping decision (AT.39740) upheld by the CJEU (C-48/22 P, 10 Sep 2024). No 2026 ruling found. ⚠ *(unverified)* Ceneo appears on media lists of firms covered by UOKiK's Omnibus price-reduction checks, with no Ceneo-specific finding.

**⚠ buyer protection path**

Click-out offers ('Idz do sklepu'): the contract is with the shop, and Ceneo excludes liability for delivery, warranty and consumer rights (terms 3.5-3.6). The buyer relies on statutory rekojmia against the seller, the 14-day withdrawal right for distance sales, and card chargeback or PayU/BLIK dispute routes depending on payment. Terms 3.10 let a consumer harmed by a seller's unlawful act claim under the POK rules. Kup Teraz offers: Ceneo is the platform, PayU processes payment, and POK covers Kup Teraz orders paid with listed methods. Help centre: compensation up to PLN 10,000; the order must be confirmed via an e-mail link within 24 hours; claims must be filed 30-120 days after the transaction with a police report; funds go to the seller if the buyer does not respond within 28 days (⚠ *(unverified)* help-centre summary, POK terms PDF not opened). Damaged goods are not covered by POK; that claim goes to the seller. Cross-border: N/A (Polish shops); for a foreign seller, use the ECC Poland route.

#### fit for user

**fit for big ticket durables**

Good for discovery and the price sweep across Polish shops; useless for safety. Trampoline example (2026-10-15): 658 trampolines with filters for diameter, net type and maximum user weight. Zipro Jumpin 10FT 312 cm costs PLN 789.90 at empik (delivery from PLN 15; shop 4.6/5 from 5,524 reviews, 'Sklep Roku 2026') vs PLN 1,075.43 at morele.net (free delivery). The card has 28 purchase-verified product reviews at 4.7/5 and an AI pros-and-cons summary. Other 10 ft models listed from PLN 399.99 to 1,284. Delivery cost per offer is visible and sortable, which matters for bulky goods. It cannot: confirm the EN 71-14 standard version, Safety Gate or UOKiK hits, GPSR responsible-person data or certificate validity; map spare nets, pads or springs; compare against Allegro, Amazon.de or brand stores; or compute returns cost for a 50 kg parcel.

**workflow role**

Price and history (Poland), plus a discovery shortlist and one input to the seller check (shop rating and verified reviews). Combine with: Skapiec (second sweep, which includes Allegro, Amazon.pl and Kaufland offers and an open 1-year history), Allegro directly, idealo or Keepa for EU prices, the Safety Gate or UOKiK registers for safety, CEIDG, KRS and the VAT white list for seller identity, and independent lab tests for model quality.

**effort and cost per purchase**

Manual: free, about 10-20 minutes per product (switch sort to 'ceny z dostawa', log in for history, check 2-3 duplicate cards). Automated (against terms 14.7): bovi/ceneo-price-scraper at USD 4.75 per 1,000 products comes to about USD 0.14 for one keyword search (about 30 products, first page only) but returns only the lowest price per product, not the shop table. studio-amba/ceneo-scraper at USD 2.00 per 1,000 results comes to about USD 0.06 for 30 results, plus the Apify account. The Partner API is free but needs affiliate approval and a website. Price snapshot cost for one product comparison: effectively zero in cash; the real cost is legal risk.

**evidence trail**

Weak built-in trail: stable product URLs (ceneo.pl/<id>) and outbound shop links, but no export, no snapshot, and a history chart only in the logged-in UI. Suggested vault record: date and time; product card URL (and any duplicate cards); sort mode used; offer table (shop, price, delivery, ship-by, shop rating with review count, badges, Kup Teraz yes or no); the paid-position notice text; a screenshot of the 6-month chart; the Superceny 30-day reference if shown. Keep raw tables and screenshots in content/_raw (not built). Publish only summarised conclusions, because terms 14.9 forbid copying or distributing Ceneo data.

#### assessment

**strengths weaknesses**

- **strengths**:
  - Deepest Polish shop coverage for durables (vendor-claimed 39,000 shops; 658 trampolines seen) with useful attribute filters
  - Purchase-verified Zaufane Opinie with documented moderation rules and post-2021 UOKiK-corrected handling of hidden reviews
  - Delivery cost per offer and a 'ceny z dostawa' sort, important for bulky goods
  - Ranking factors and paid positions disclosed in the terms and on-page ('Pozycje ofert zostaly oplacone', bold = paid)
  - Kup Teraz plus POK buyer protection up to PLN 10,000 for marketplace orders
- **weaknesses**:
  - Default product and offer orders are shaped by CPC and paid auctions; Allegro-group ownership and Allegro-paid ads
  - Price history needs a login, covers only 6 months and shows an aggregate lowest-price trend; no per-shop Omnibus display
  - Duplicate product cards and AI-filled catalogue data; missed a PLN 180 cheaper offer that Skapiec showed for the same model
  - No safety, GPSR or seller-identity checks
  - Closed to automation: terms ban bots (PLN 50,000 penalty clause), no consumer API or MCP, ClaudeBot blocked

**independent review consensus**

No independent test of Ceneo's ranking quality or coverage was found. Consumer-tech media (Spider's Web 2022, Antyweb Jan 2024, Benchmark, Telepolis, Picodi Apr 2026) consistently describe the 6-month logged-in price history and price alerts. Consumer journalism (Bezprawnik Dec 2021) criticises seller vetting. UOKiK's 2021 intervention confirms a past review-hiding problem. Much recent Ceneo coverage is paid: Antyweb 27 May 2026 is labelled 'Artykul sponsorowany', and Spider's Web Feb 2025 ('20 lat Ceneo w liczbach') is labelled 'Lokowanie produktu: ceneo.pl'. Picodi is a coupon and affiliate publisher. Treat those as vendor-adjacent.

**verdict for me**

USE NOW (manual only). Deciding fact: it is the largest free index of Polish shop offers with verified reviews and delivery-inclusive sorting, but its terms forbid automation (14.7) and the default order is paid. Best use: open the category, filter by diameter, net type and weight, switch the offer sort to 'ceny z dostawa: najnizszej', check for duplicate cards, log in for the 6-month trend, and save a dated offer table plus screenshot into the vault's _raw area. Then cross-check the same EAN on Skapiec and Allegro.

**conflicting evidence**

- Paid placement in 'Wybrane oferty': the product page tooltip says the order depends on a paid auction of Ceneo partners, while the help centre describes 'Oferty wybrane przez Ceneo' as chosen on ratings, availability, price and the Zaufane Opinie badge, without mentioning payment.
- Zaufane Opinie survey sender: terms 5.3 say the survey is sent by the seller using Ceneo tools (by Ceneo only for Kup Teraz buyers), while info.ceneo.pl/zaufane-opinie says Ceneo e-mails the buyer after purchase.
- Shop scale: vendor-claimed 39,000 registered shops and 349.5 million offers (Feb 2025, paid placement) vs 18,000 shops and 23 million offers (H1 2020, secondary), and the info page's unquantified 'thousands of verified shops'.
- Traffic: about 32.3 million visits per month (SimilarWeb Apr 2025 via seigi.eu) vs 70 million visits per month (vendor, Feb 2025) vs 'over 30 million' (Bezprawnik Jul 2026).
- Shop ratings across platforms on 2026-10-15: Media Expert 4.7/5 (3,430 reviews) on Ceneo vs 2.1/5 (14,741) on Opineo/Skapiec; ELECTRO.pl 1.5/5 (22) on Ceneo vs 4.0/5 (74,322) on Opineo.
- Price-history refresh: Picodi (Apr 2026) says every 5 days; Spider's Web (2022) describes a daily average; Ceneo pages give no frequency.
- Apify actors for Ceneo: the Step-2 outline said none were found, but on 2026-10-15 at least five community actors were live (bovi, studio-amba, trev0n, noahadler, reviewscraper).

### Asystent Ceneo

**Verdict:** WATCH · **Cost:** Free · **Verified:** 2026-10-15 · 8 field(s) flagged ⚠

#### identity

**basics**

Asystent Ceneo ('Asystent AI Ceneo' in the terms) is a conversational, LLM-based shopping assistant built into Ceneo.pl, opened from a robot icon, with text and voice input. Per the vendor and Annex 5 it searches and compares Ceneo products and offers and explains technical parameters. It suggests better-value alternatives and the most popular choices, and answers questions about the product page the user is on. For logged-in users it answers Ceneo service questions from a knowledge base and searches Kup Teraz purchase history (order and shipment status). On explicit command it adds products to the Kup Teraz cart. Newer feature on the page: discovering cultural events. Related Ceneo AI features: 'ZapytAI' (an AI answer to a search-bar question) and AI review summaries on product pages ('CeneoAI', built from the 'most useful' reviews). Role type: AI assistant, first-party, sitting on top of a comparison engine. Name clash: 'Ceneo Asystent' on biznes.ceneo.pl is an unrelated free e-mail digest for merchants.

**vendor and ownership**

Ceneo.pl sp. z o.o., Wroclaw (KRS 0000634928), a subsidiary of Allegro.eu S.A. The vendor page says the assistant is 'Napedzane technologia OpenAI' (powered by OpenAI technology); the exact model is not disclosed. Annex 5, section 8 lists 'providers of AI models' among data recipients. Funding is internal to the Allegro group. Bias note: the owner also runs the Kup Teraz marketplace, and the assistant's cart and order functions work only for Kup Teraz.

**lifecycle status**

Launched; live. Launch: around 27 May 2026. Trade-press items are dated 27 May 2026 (dlahandlu.pl, tabletowo.pl, antyweb.pl sponsored), 28 May 2026 (wiadomoscihandlowe.pl) and 1 June 2026 (omnichannelnews.pl); Ceneo's own page gives no date. Latest change found: the terms version effective 2026-08-01 added Annex 5 'Asystent AI', and the vendor page lists a new events-discovery feature and a 'Design & Usability' (Design Roku) award at the e-Commerce Polska Awards 2026. No beta label. Annex 5 section 10.1 says the service is provided 'as is' and may be changed, limited or switched off. Verified 2026-10-15 from the vendor page and terms; all sources are under 6 months old.

**cost model**

Free. Anonymous users have a cap on questions per conversation thread, shown inside the assistant; the number is not published. Logged-in users have no cap, apart from abuse controls (Annex 5, section 4.2). No paid tier. Seen 2026-10-15, Poland.

**⚠ feature geo matrix**

- **Poland**: Available on ceneo.pl (desktop and mobile browsers). The vendor FAQ also says it is in the Ceneo mobile app; Annex 5 section 1.3 says only 'on the pages of the Ceneo Service' (⚠ *(unverified)* app availability). Voice input, page-context answers, chat history and order status (logged in, Kup Teraz only), and add-to-cart (Kup Teraz).
- **EU outside Poland**: Reachable on ceneo.pl, but it only knows Ceneo's Polish offers. The vendor claims it detects the language of the question and answers in that language ('poliglota'); untested.
- **US**: N/A.
- **language**: Polish interface. Answers in the user's language (vendor-claimed).
- **other channels**: No Ceneo app inside ChatGPT, no MCP server and no API found (checked 2026-10-15).
- **US only or agentic features**: None. No autonomous checkout; cart actions only on explicit command.

#### capabilities

**⚠ spec and variant comparison**

⚠ *(unverified)* Vendor-claimed only. It says it can point out key differences between selected models, explain hard technical parameters, find better-value alternatives, and answer spec questions in the context of the open product page (vendor example: does this model have a headphone jack). It draws on the Ceneo catalogue, which has known duplicate cards and AI-filled data (terms 14.5). No evidence of EAN, regional-name or OEM-rebadge mapping. Untested on a trampoline lineup (e.g. Zipro Jumpin vs Jump Pro, 8/10/12/14 ft).

**price comparison and pl coverage**

Coverage equals the Ceneo index: Polish shops listing on Ceneo plus Kup Teraz sellers, with no Allegro or Amazon offers on tested cards and no EU shops (see the 'Ceneo' item). Vendor claims: it 'analyzes millions of offers, reviews and parameters' and searches 'millions of offers in real time'; ZapytAI 'analyzes hundreds of offers' per question. Whether answers show every shop's offer or only a top pick is undocumented. Untested.

**⚠ price history and omnibus**

⚠ *(unverified)* Not documented. Unknown whether the assistant can read Ceneo's 6-month price trend (which needs a login in the UI) or the 30-day cross-shop reference used on Superceny pages. No Omnibus check or fake-discount detection is claimed.

**⚠ total landed cost**

⚠ *(unverified)* Not documented. Annex 5 section 3.1 covers 'products, prices and availability'; delivery cost, returns and assembly are not mentioned. Assume it does not compute landed cost unless a manual test shows otherwise.

**review and seller verification**

Partial at most, inherited from Ceneo. The vendor says it analyses buyer reviews; Ceneo's separate AI review summary uses the 'most useful' reviews. No documented use of the Zaufane Opinie flag, shop ratings or seller identity checks inside answers. It cannot prove shop legitimacy or review authenticity.

**safety and compliance checks**

None. Annex 5 forbids using it for medical, legal or financial advice, and Ceneo excludes liability for decisions made on its answers (section 5.3). No Safety Gate, UOKiK, GPSR, standard-version or certificate checks.

**independent test coverage**

None surfaced. The vendor mentions 'filters, rankings and reviews' (Ceneo popularity rankings and user reviews), not lab tests.

**alerts and monitoring**

No alert or monitoring function in the assistant. Ceneo's own price alerts are separate (see the 'Ceneo' item). For logged-in users it may greet returning visitors with suggestions based on their needs (vendor FAQ), which is a personalisation feature, not monitoring.

**purchase automation and guardrails**

Limited and human-confirmed. It can add products to the Kup Teraz cart only 'on the user's explicit command' (Annex 5, section 3.1). It 'does not make purchase decisions or take steps leading to a contract without the user's explicit command' (section 4.1). Adding to the cart does not form a contract; the sale happens only through Kup Teraz checkout (section 4.3), with PayU as payment operator and each shop as seller. Section 5.1 tells the user to check the cart contents and the full offer. No spending caps, mandates or agent payment rails. On error: Ceneo excludes liability as far as the law allows (section 5.3); Kup Teraz complaint and POK routes apply.

**after sales and resale**

Order and shipment status for Kup Teraz orders when logged in to the ordering account. No spare-parts, service or resale features.

#### data and integration

**⚠ data sources and freshness**

Language models (OpenAI technology, vendor-claimed) plus Ceneo service data 'in particular products, offers' and a knowledge base (Annex 5, sections 2-3). For logged-in users it can also use Kup Teraz order data (number, status, date, products, delivery and payment info; section 7.1). Freshness follows Ceneo's feed refresh (hours). Annex 5 section 9 warns answers may be outdated. ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether each answer links to the Ceneo product cards or offers it used is not documented; no source citations are described.

**api mcp skill access**

Grade: none. No API, no MCP server, no Claude skill, no CLI and no ChatGPT app. Browser-agent use is technically possible but contractually barred. Terms 14.7 ban automated access without written consent. Annex 5 section 6.1 forbids trying to bypass safeguards and mass-downloading data to build competing databases. Section 12.3 forbids commercial use, public sharing, copying, bulk download, and using outputs to build databases or price comparators or to train other AI models. Ceneo's robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot and Claude-SearchBot. The only legitimate route is manual use in a browser. Setup effort: none for manual use.

**protocol support**

None (no MCP, ACP, UCP or AP2). Uses OpenAI technology internally (vendor-claimed), but exposes nothing to outside agents.

**open source and licence**

closed

**account linking and data access**

Optional Ceneo account (e-mail, Google, Facebook or Allegro login). Logged in: chat history is tied to the account and kept until the account is deleted. The assistant may read Kup Teraz order history, including delivery and payment information (Annex 5, sections 7.1 and 7.4). Anonymous: capped conversation and no stored history beyond that mode (section 7.4). Data is processed 'as a rule' in the EEA; any transfer outside the EEA uses GDPR safeguards (section 8). Recipients include AI model providers. Legal bases: GDPR art. 6(1)(b) contract and 6(1)(f) legitimate interest. Data is not used to train base AI models, but selected chats may be analysed for safety and product development (section 9). No solely automated decisions with legal effect. Users must not enter personal data (section 6.1). Voice input uses the microphone. Before Annex 5 (effective 2026-08-01) no privacy terms existed; the Step-2 note 'no privacy data published' is now outdated.

**automation legal risk**

High for any scripted use (terms 14.7-14.10: PLN 50,000 contractual penalty per data-copying violation; Annex 5 sections 6.1 and 12.3). Personal manual use is licensed: a non-exclusive, free licence to use outputs 'for personal use connected with individual purchase decisions' (section 12.2). Public sharing of outputs is forbidden, which matters because the buyer's vault is published as a public website. Keep any transcript in the non-published _raw area and publish only your own conclusions.

#### trust and bias

**⚠ monetization and bias vector**

Free; monetises through Ceneo's CPC, paid position auctions and Kup Teraz. Annex 5 section 5.2: answers are not advertising or paid product recommendations unless an element is clearly labelled as an ad, promotion or sponsored content. That is a policy claim, not an audited fact. Unresolved bias paths: (1) ⚠ *(unverified)* whether retrieval uses Ceneo's default 'Rekomendowane' or 'Najlepsze' orders, which include CPC and auction factors (terms 3.18-3.19), or a neutral price order; (2) cart and order functions exist only for Kup Teraz, steering purchases into Ceneo's own marketplace; (3) 'most frequently chosen by other buyers' suggestions lean on popularity; (4) group ownership by Allegro. No usage or revenue data published.

**ranking transparency**

Low. Marketing promises 'only the best options' and 'the best value for money' without stating the criteria, weights or sources behind a pick. Sources cannot be excluded and no audit or evaluation is published. Labelling of sponsored items is promised in Annex 5 section 5.2, but its look is not documented and was not observed.

**⚠ run to run consistency**

⚠ *(unverified)* No evidence published and not tested here (the test needs the user to accept the assistant terms; scripted repetition is barred). As an LLM retrieval system with personalisation for logged-in users, the shortlist and wording may change between runs. Suggested manual test: ask the same Polish query three times, anonymous and logged in, e.g. 'trampolina ogrodowa 305-312 cm z siatka zewnetrzna do 1000 zl, max 150 kg', and compare the product IDs and prices returned.

**manipulation and injection resistance**

Untested. Annex 5 says Ceneo applies measures against manipulative, disinformation and consumer-rights-violating content (section 5.4), uses automatic moderation and safety filters (section 9) and keeps permanent human oversight (section 11). Exposure: answers are built from seller-supplied offer titles and descriptions, user reviews and AI-filled catalogue text, all of which could carry persuasive or injected text. No red-team or Scamlexity-style results published. Fake-shop risk is inherited from Ceneo (see the 'Ceneo' item).

**known failures**

No documented user-reported failures found as of 2026-10-15; no independent tests exist. Annex 5 warns that answers 'may contain errors, inaccuracies or outdated information' and must be verified, especially cart contents. Inherited data risks: duplicate product cards, AI-generated catalogue specs, Polish-only coverage, a paid-influenced default order. Documentation mismatch: the FAQ says it is in the mobile app, while the terms say it is on the Ceneo website.

**regulatory enforcement history**

None found for the assistant. AI Act: Annex 5 section 1.2 says users are told they are talking to an AI system, not a human (the Art. 50 transparency duty). The platform-level history (UOKiK 2021 review-hiding intervention; Ceneo v Google litigation) is in the 'Ceneo' item.

**⚠ buyer protection path**

Same as Ceneo. Purchases via the assistant go through Kup Teraz: the shop is the seller, PayU handles payment, and POK covers eligible Kup Teraz orders (help centre: up to PLN 10,000) ⚠ *(unverified)* (POK terms PDF not opened). Statutory rekojmia and the 14-day withdrawal right apply against the shop. Click-out offers fall under the shop's terms.

#### fit for user

**fit for big ticket durables**

Limited and unproven. Possible value for the trampoline: turning a plain-language need (diameter 305-312 cm, outer net, 150 kg user, budget) into a first shortlist from Ceneo's 658 trampolines, and explaining terms (inner vs outer net, spring count, mat size). It cannot verify safety (EN 71-14 version, Safety Gate), cannot show a documented price-history or landed-cost view, does not cite sources, and might be steered towards Kup Teraz or paid offers in ways nobody has audited. Every pick must be re-checked on the Ceneo product page sorted by 'ceny z dostawa'.

**workflow role**

Discovery and spec explanation (step 1), plus order tracking for Kup Teraz purchases. Combine with Ceneo listings (price-with-delivery sort, 6-month history), Skapiec for a second price sweep, safety registers, seller identity registers and lab tests.

**effort and cost per purchase**

Free. About 5-10 minutes of manual chat per product category. A login is needed for history and to avoid the anonymous question cap. No API, token or proxy costs, and no automated option.

**evidence trail**

Poor. Logged-in chat history is kept in the account, but no export or citation format is documented. Manual record for the vault: date, exact query, a short summary of the answer, and the Ceneo product IDs and prices it suggested, each re-checked on the product page. Licence limits (Annex 5, sections 12.2-12.3) allow personal use only, so keep verbatim transcripts out of published notes.

#### assessment

**strengths weaknesses**

- **strengths**:
  - Free, first-party AI layer over the largest Polish comparison index (Ceneo), in Polish with voice input
  - Clear written guardrails: no purchase without an explicit command, add-to-cart only, answers not ads unless labelled (Annex 5, sections 4.1 and 5.2)
  - Published GDPR terms: EEA processing as a rule, no training of base models on user data, human oversight (Annex 5, sections 8-11)
  - Page-context answers on product cards can speed up spec questions
- **weaknesses**:
  - No API, MCP or ChatGPT app; automation and public reuse of outputs are forbidden
  - Ranking method undisclosed; the underlying Ceneo order includes CPC and paid auctions, and cart and order features favour Kup Teraz
  - No independent test, no consistency data and no citations in answers
  - No price-history, landed-cost or safety capability documented
  - Uncertain scope: app availability conflicts between FAQ and terms; anonymous question cap undisclosed

**independent review consensus**

No independent evidence found. All coverage found is launch reporting based on Ceneo press material (dlahandlu.pl 27 May 2026, tabletowo.pl 27 May 2026, wiadomoscihandlowe.pl 28 May 2026 (paywalled), omnichannelnews.pl 1 June 2026, handelextra, ewp.pl). antyweb.pl 27 May 2026 (also syndicated on strefabiznesu.pl) is labelled 'Artykul sponsorowany' (sponsored). None of these describe hands-on answers. The 'Design & Usability' award is an industry award, not a quality test. Tabletowo remarks it is not revolutionary, since Allegro launched its own assistant and a ChatGPT app in May 2026.

**verdict for me**

WATCH. Deciding fact: it cannot be driven from Claude Code (no API or MCP, automation and public reuse forbidden), its ranking is unaudited, and nobody has tested it independently, so it adds little over Ceneo's own filters. Best single use if you try it: one manual Polish-language prompt to brainstorm a model shortlist and explain spec terms, then verify every suggested product ID on Ceneo and Skapiec listings before it enters the vault.

**conflicting evidence**

- Platforms: the vendor FAQ says it is available in the mobile app and in browsers; terms Annex 5 section 1.3 says it is available 'on the pages of the Ceneo Service'; Omnichannel News (1 June 2026) and Tabletowo mention only the website.
- AI provider: the Ceneo page states 'powered by OpenAI technology'; none of the launch articles name a provider.
- Privacy: the Step-2 outline note said 'no usage or privacy data published'. Since the 2026-08-01 terms, Annex 5 publishes data categories, retention, EEA processing and a no-training clause. Usage figures are still unpublished (Allegro, by contrast, reported 600 thousand users for its assistant's test).
- ZapytAI vs Asystent: info.ceneo.pl/ceneo-ai presents ZapytAI (search-bar AI answer) separately from Asystent Ceneo; Omnichannel News describes ZapytAI as part of the assistant flow. Their relationship is unclear.
- Name collision: 'Ceneo Asystent' on biznes.ceneo.pl is a free merchant e-mail digest, not the shopping assistant.

**sources checked**

- **primary**:
  - https://www.ceneo.pl/wydarzenia/asystent-ceneo - vendor page and FAQ, 'powered by OpenAI technology', award (accessed 2026-10-15)
  - https://shops.ceneo.pl/documents/VersionedDocuments/Current/CeneoUserServiceAgreement - Regulamin Serwisu Ceneo effective 01.08.2026, Annex 5 'Asystent AI' sections 1-12 (accessed 2026-10-15)
  - https://info.ceneo.pl/ceneo-ai - ZapytAI and AI review summaries (accessed 2026-10-15)
  - https://biznes.ceneo.pl/asystent-ceneo - merchant 'Ceneo Asystent' e-mail digest, name collision (accessed 2026-10-15)
  - https://www.ceneo.pl/90991500 - product page showing the 'CeneoAI' review summary (accessed 2026-10-15)
  - https://www.ceneo.pl/robots.txt - ClaudeBot and Claude-SearchBot blocked (accessed 2026-10-15)
- **secondary**:
  - https://www.dlahandlu.pl/e-commerce/asystent-ceneo-ma-skrocic-zakupy-wyszukiwanie-dziala-jak-rozmowa,170879.html - launch report, 27 May 2026 (opened 2026-10-15)
  - https://www.tabletowo.pl/nowosc-na-ceneo-asystent-ai/ - launch report, 27 May 2026 (opened 2026-10-15)

#### fields the agent listed as uncertain

- buyer protection path
- data sources and freshness
