### Skapiec and Nokaut

**Verdict:** Skapiec PILOT, Nokaut SKIP (closed) · **Cost:** Free · **Verified:** 2026-10-15 · 8 field(s) flagged ⚠

#### identity

**basics**

Two Polish price comparison engines covered as one item. SKAPIEC.PL (live): a comparison engine founded 13 October 2004. It compares offers from thousands of Polish shops and adds open price history, e-mail price alerts, popularity rankings, editorial guides ('Skapiec radzi', 'Skapiec News') and shop and product reviews taken from its sister site Opineo.pl. NOKAUT.PL (discontinued): a former comparison engine from Gdynia. It closed with a statement dated 20 December 2024 and stopped showing offers by January 2025. nokaut.pl now redirects (301) to salesintelligence.pl and then media.digitree.pl (verified 2026-10-15). Role type: comparison engine (Skapiec); discontinued comparison engine (Nokaut).

**⚠ vendor and ownership**

Skapiec: operated by Ringier Axel Springer Polska sp. z o.o. (RASP, Warsaw), the owner of Onet.pl, Fakt and Newsweek Polska. Onet bought 80% of Skapiec.pl (and Opineo.pl) in 2014, and RASP took over all of Skapiec's assets in the 2018 merger (Skapiec /o-nas page). Skapiec is 'closely linked' with Onet Ads, RASP's self-service ad platform. Opineo.pl, the source of its reviews, is also RASP-owned. ⚠ *(unverified)* The ultimate parent above RASP (Ringier / Axel Springer group structure) was not verified. Owned by a media group with an ad business, not by a marketplace, so it has no self-preferencing of its own shop, but sister-company Opineo badges feed its ranking. Nokaut: last operated by Sales Intelligence (president Wiktor Mazur signed the closure statement). ⚠ *(unverified)* Sales Intelligence appears to belong to Digitree Group (formerly SARE S.A.): SARE announced a deal to buy it from HubStyle (formerly Grupa Nokaut S.A.) for about PLN 1.9 m, and nokaut.pl now redirects to media.digitree.pl. Completion of that deal was not confirmed.

**lifecycle status**

Skapiec: live. Launched 2004-10-13; redesigned in 2023; user terms updated 2025-03-26 (DSA alignment, notice-and-action, recommender system disclosure). The site carried '(c) Skapiec 2026' and 'Ranking trampolin - pazdziernik 2026' when opened on 2026-10-15. No AI assistant found (search 2026-10-15). Nokaut: discontinued. Closure statement dated 2024-12-20 (Tabletowo, 20 Dec 2024; seigi.eu says operations ended in January 2025). SimilarWeb measured about 7,000 visits in April 2025, 56% down month on month (via seigi.eu). The redirect to Digitree was verified on 2026-10-15. The Nokaut Search API client (github.com/nokaut/api-kit) is archived (last push 2023-04-25), and nokaut.io returned HTTP 522 on 2026-10-15.

**cost model**

Skapiec: free for consumers. Price history and price alerts work without an account (alerts need an e-mail address). Merchants pay per click-out ('Koszt przekliku do sklepu'), set a monthly budget, can buy 'Promowana oferta' placement, and can advertise via Onet Ads. Seen 2026-10-15, Poland. Nokaut: N/A (closed).

**⚠ feature geo matrix**

- **Poland**: Skapiec: offer comparison, open price history (14 days, 3 months, 6 months, 1 year), e-mail price alerts (no account, 6-month validity), Opineo shop ratings and badges, filters for free shipping, InPost, pick-up, instalments, 'Autoryzowane sklepy' and 'Certyfikat Opineo', popularity rankings, editorial guides. No checkout, no AI assistant, no mobile app found (⚠ *(unverified)* app not searched exhaustively).
- **EU outside Poland**: N/A. Polish shops only (some German-language product names from feeds, e.g. Salta 'Gartentrampolin', but the offers are Polish shops).
- **US**: N/A.
- **language**: Polish only.
- **US only or agentic features**: None.
- **Nokaut**: Closed everywhere since Dec 2024 / Jan 2025.

#### capabilities

**⚠ spec and variant comparison**

Weak to partial (Skapiec). Category filters for trampolines: producer, with or without net, type (garden, home, fitness), diameter buckets (e.g. 305 cm: 23 products, 312 cm: 38, 366 cm: 14), shape and shop. A product card has a spec table and a 'Porownaj z podobnymi' (compare with similar) block. Observed data-quality problems on 2026-10-15: the Salta Premium Black 305x214 card mixes values for 305 cm and 396 cm variants in one spec table. The description is marked 'Tresci powstaly przy wsparciu narzedzia sztucznej inteligencji' (written with AI help). Product names copy raw feed titles, some in German. No visible EAN, regional-name or OEM-rebadge mapping. ⚠ *(unverified)* How the catalogue matches offers to a product is not documented. Nokaut: N/A.

**price comparison and pl coverage**

Yes (Skapiec). Vendor claim: an overview of offers from 'thousands' of online shops covering 'millions of products', updated daily (/o-nas). Secondary figures conflict: Antyweb (May 2020) says about 11 million products from about 3,100 shops; Polish Wikipedia says 6 million products from 13,000+ shops (undated). Observed 2026-10-15, trampolines: 895 products, with a shop filter listing Empik.com (414), Kaufland.pl (334), Decathlon.pl (235), Morele.net (190), Leroy Merlin (112), Allegro (54), Fitshop (47), ovolt.eu (32), Avans.pl (30), ELECTRO.pl (30), Mediaexpert.pl (30), sferis.pl (26), Amazon.pl (6), lidl.pl (6), home.biedronka.pl (4), Castorama, OBI and others. So Allegro, Amazon.pl and Kaufland marketplace offers do appear, unlike on the Ceneo cards tested. Same-model test on Salta Premium Black 5362: 11 offers, cheapest PLN 2,099.00 at Kaufland.pl, vs Ceneo's 9 offers from PLN 2,279.54. Traffic: about 3 million visits per month vs Ceneo about 32.3 million (SimilarWeb April 2025, via seigi.eu, secondary). No EU shops. Nokaut: none (closed).

**⚠ price history and omnibus**

Skapiec: the product page has a 'Historia cen' block with 14d, 3m, 6m and 1r (1 year) buttons and a 'Sprawdz historie cen' link; the chart loads on click (placeholder text 'Sprawdz historie i ustaw alert cenowy'). Picodi (8 Apr 2026) says no login is needed and the chart shows the lowest price in the chosen range, the current best offer and the trend; Picodi lists 14 days, 30 days, 3, 6 and 12 months, while the live page on 2026-10-15 showed 14d, 3m, 6m and 1r. ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether history is per shop or aggregate; the chart itself could not be rendered without a browser. Omnibus: no per-shop 'lowest price in the 30 days before the reduction' was shown on the product page checked. A category sort 'Obnizka' (discount) orders products by discount % but does not say what reference price the % uses (⚠ *(unverified)*). No fake-discount flag. The 1-year open history is still a better manual check of a discount claim than Ceneo's 6-month logged-in view. Nokaut: N/A.

**⚠ total landed cost**

Weak (Skapiec). Offers show badges such as 'Darmowa wysylka', 'Wysylka w 24h/48h', 'Wysylka do 3 dni', 'Odbior osobisty', 'Raty' and 'Szybkie platnosci', and filters for free shipping, InPost and personal pick-up. ⚠ *(unverified)* No per-offer delivery price appeared on the product page checked (Ceneo shows one); Antyweb 2020 said Skapiec compares delivery costs, so it may show for some offers. No payment fees, assembly, returns or cross-border warranty. Nokaut: N/A.

**review and seller verification**

Partial (Skapiec). Shop ratings, review counts and badges ('Odznaka podstawowa/srebrna Opineo', 'Certyfikat Opineo') come from sister site Opineo.pl (terms Art. 3.1d). Product reviews also come from Opineo; most trampoline cards show 'Brak opinii' (no reviews), so product-level review evidence is thin. A filter for 'Autoryzowane sklepy' (authorised shops) exists; its criteria were not verified. Opineo's verification method was not checked here; Opineo was part of UOKiK's 2021 soft intervention on hiding negative reviews. Ratings diverge sharply from Ceneo on the same day: Media Expert 2.1/5 (14,741 Opineo reviews) vs 4.7/5 (3,430) on Ceneo; ELECTRO.pl 4.0/5 (74,322) vs 1.5/5 (22). No CEIDG, KRS, VAT white list or VIES data. It cannot prove shop legitimacy or review authenticity. Nokaut: N/A.

**safety and compliance checks**

None (Skapiec). Only a DSA 'Zglos kwestie prawna' (report a legal issue) link on product specs and a general notice-and-action process (terms, 2025-03-26). No Safety Gate, UOKiK register, GPSR, EN 71-14 or certificate checks. Nokaut: N/A.

**independent test coverage**

None. Skapiec 'rankings' (e.g. 'Ranking trampolin - pazdziernik 2026') order products by click-outs to shops in the last 14 days (/zasady-sortowania), which measures popularity, not quality. Editorial 'Skapiec radzi' guides are RASP content, and the terms state product and shop materials are commercial information. No lab tests surfaced. Nokaut: N/A.

**alerts and monitoring**

Skapiec 'Alert Cenowy' (terms Art. 7): no account needed. The user enters an e-mail and a target price and confirms by double opt-in; an e-mail arrives when the price is reached in the service. Each alert lasts 6 months by default, several alerts may be grouped into one e-mail, and alert e-mails may carry marketing content. Channel: e-mail only. Check frequency not published. It watches Skapiec-listed offers only, not arbitrary shop pages. Nokaut: none.

**purchase automation and guardrails**

No. Skapiec is not a seller and not a party to transactions; it only links out to shops (terms Art. 3.2), and the user must verify price, features, product identity and photos on the shop page. No checkout, agent or payment features. Nokaut: N/A.

**after sales and resale**

None beyond browsing the separate 'Akcesoria do trampolin' category for spare parts. Product pages carry a consumer-loan ad ('Finansowanie', VeloBank). No service network, warranty or resale features. Nokaut: N/A.

#### data and integration

**data sources and freshness**

Skapiec: shop feeds via shop-platform integrations (Shoper, Sellingo and others), described as 'updated daily' (vendor). Click-outs go through tracked redirect links (/site/red/...). Some descriptions are AI-assisted. The terms (Art. 3.2) put the burden of checking price, features, product identity and photos on the user, which signals that feed errors are expected. No snapshots or citations. Nokaut: no data since early 2025.

**⚠ api mcp skill access**

Grade: none. Skapiec: no current public API found. The legacy api.skapiec.pl returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-15. The only client library, mdurys/skapiec-api (PHP, MIT, 3 stars), was last pushed 2016-02-17. No official or community MCP server and no Claude skill. ⚠ *(unverified)* No Apify actor for Skapiec was found in the searches run, which were not exhaustive. GitHub has only student scrapers (0 stars). Plain HTTP GET of pages worked on 2026-10-15 (WebFetch was refused), but terms Art. 5.3 forbid automated access, aggregation and presenting the data outside the service without written permission. Fallback: manual use. Nokaut: a Search API (OAuth) existed with a PHP client (nokaut/api-kit, MIT, 6 stars, archived after its last push 2023-04-25), and nokaut.io is down (HTTP 522), so it is dead. Setup effort: none for manual use; there is no legitimate automated route.

**protocol support**

None (Skapiec and Nokaut). No MCP, ACP, UCP or AP2.

**open source and licence**

closed (Skapiec). Nokaut: closed service; only the archived MIT client library nokaut/api-kit was public.

**account linking and data access**

Skapiec: no account needed for browsing, history or alerts; alerts and the newsletter need an e-mail. Newsletter consent sends RASP marketing that may come 'on behalf of its Trusted Partners'. The privacy policy is Onet's (polityka-prywatnosci.onet.pl), so the RASP/Onet ad stack and cookie consent apply; decline non-essential cookies. No payment data is ever needed. Nokaut: N/A.

**automation legal risk**

Medium to high for scraping, low for manual use. Skapiec terms Art. 5.3 forbid access other than by a browser, automated access, copying, aggregating or modifying data, and automatically downloading content to show it elsewhere without written permission. Art. 3.3 says the database is legally protected, and the EU sui generis database right applies. robots.txt blocks a long list of bots (no rule for Anthropic agents found). No anti-bot wall was met with simple GET requests on 2026-10-15. Nokaut: N/A.

#### trust and bias

**monetization and bias vector**

Skapiec's default offer order 'Najlepsze oferty' uses six factors, listed most important first (/zasady-sortowania): (1) price, (2) the shop's cost per click-out, (3) Opineo shop rating, (4) the shop's monthly budget, (5) Opineo review count, (6) badges such as free delivery, instalments and fast payments. Two of the six are paid. A labelled 'Promowana oferta' sits above the list. Example seen 2026-10-15 on Salta Premium Black 5362: the promoted offer was Media Expert at PLN 2,399.99 (Opineo 2.1/5), while Kaufland.pl offered PLN 2,099.00, so the promoted offer was 14% dearer than the cheapest. The offer list is headed 'INFORMACJA HANDLOWA' (commercial information), with 'Reklama' ad slots, including a consumer-loan ad. Category default 'Popularnosc' uses click-outs in the last 14 days, with no paid factor disclosed. Other vectors: RASP media ownership and the Onet Ads tie-in; sister-company Opineo badges and certificates feed the ranking (a self-preferencing risk for Opineo-certified shops). Nokaut: N/A.

**ranking transparency**

Good disclosure for a comparison site. A public page lists the ranking factors in order of importance (no weights), and promoted offers are labelled. Users can sort by price or shop rating and filter by free shipping, Opineo certificate and authorised shops; the shop filter on category pages allows narrowing to chosen shops. Weights and CPC amounts are not disclosed. Nokaut: N/A.

**run to run consistency**

N/A (non-AI listings). The promoted slot and the 'Najlepsze oferty' order can change as CPC and budgets change; the price sort is deterministic at a point in time.

**manipulation and injection resistance**

N/A for prompt injection (no LLM interface). Review integrity depends on Opineo. The DSA notice-and-action mechanism exists, but no specific fake-shop safeguards or public removal statistics were found. Nokaut: N/A.

**⚠ known failures**

Skapiec: (1) thin product reviews ('Brak opinii' on most trampolines); (2) spec tables that mix variants (305 vs 396 cm) and raw German feed titles; (3) AI-written descriptions; (4) per-offer delivery cost not shown on the page checked (⚠ *(unverified)*); (5) a promoted offer 14% above the cheapest one; (6) traffic about one tenth of Ceneo's (April 2025, secondary), which may mean fewer shops bid there; (7) WebFetch blocked. Nokaut: shut down after an organic-traffic collapse; seigi.eu (a PrestaShop module vendor blog) blames Google updates and over-reliance on SEO, which is its own interpretation, not the owner's.

**⚠ regulatory enforcement history**

No UOKiK, DSA or court decision against Skapiec or Nokaut found. Related: Opineo.pl (RASP, Skapiec's review source) was one of the two platforms in UOKiK's April 2021 soft intervention over hiding negative reviews; both changed their rules and no fine was imposed. Nokaut history (Google delisting in 2012, malware warning in 2013) comes only from seigi.eu (⚠ *(unverified)*).

**buyer protection path**

Skapiec: click-out only. The shop is the merchant of record and Skapiec bears no transaction liability (terms Art. 3.2). Protection comes from statutory rekojmia against the shop, the 14-day withdrawal right for distance sales, and card chargeback or BLIK/PayU disputes depending on payment. No platform buyer-protection programme (unlike Ceneo Kup Teraz POK). Marketplace offers listed on Skapiec (Allegro, Kaufland.pl, Amazon.pl) carry those marketplaces' own protection. Nokaut: N/A.

#### fit for user

**fit for big ticket durables**

Skapiec is useful as a second sweep for the trampoline. It shows 895 trampolines with diameter filters (305 cm: 23; 312 cm: 38), and its shops include Kaufland.pl, Allegro, Amazon.pl, Decathlon.pl and Leroy Merlin. The Salta Premium Black 305x214 example came out PLN 180 below the best Ceneo offer the same day (PLN 2,099 vs 2,279.54). Its open 1-year price history lets you test a 'discount' claim without logging in, and an e-mail alert can watch the target price for 6 months. Weak spots for this purchase: almost no product reviews, unreliable spec tables, no visible delivery cost for a bulky parcel, a promoted dearer offer at the top, and no safety or standard data. Nokaut: nothing (closed).

**workflow role**

Skapiec: second-source price sweep and history check (1 year, no login), plus a coverage check for marketplace offers (Allegro, Kaufland, Amazon.pl) that Ceneo may miss. Combine with Ceneo (verified reviews, delivery-inclusive sort), Allegro directly, seller registers (CEIDG, KRS, VAT white list) and safety registers. Nokaut: none; remove from any workflow.

**effort and cost per purchase**

Skapiec: free, about 5-10 minutes per product manually; no login; optional e-mail alert. No API or legitimate automated option, so no per-run cost. Nokaut: N/A.

**evidence trail**

Skapiec: stable product URLs (/site/cat/<category>/comp/<id>), an offer list with shop logos, prices, badges and Opineo ratings, and a history chart in the UI; no export or snapshot. Suggested vault record: date, product URL, sort mode, the 'Promowana oferta' entry flagged as paid, the full offer list sorted by price, and a screenshot of the 1-year history. Keep raw copies in the non-published _raw area; terms Art. 5.3 forbid copying data outside the service. Nokaut: N/A.

#### assessment

**strengths weaknesses**

- **strengths**:
  - Price history open without login, up to 1 year (14d/3m/6m/1r), better than Ceneo's 6-month logged-in view
  - Wider marketplace coverage on the tested category: Allegro, Amazon.pl and Kaufland.pl offers listed; found a PLN 180 cheaper offer than Ceneo for the same model
  - Transparent ranking page listing factors in order, and labelled 'Promowana oferta'
  - E-mail price alerts without an account (6-month validity)
- **weaknesses**:
  - Paid factors (cost per click-out, monthly budget) inside the default 'Najlepsze oferty' order; promoted offer seen 14% above the cheapest
  - Thin product reviews; shop ratings from sister site Opineo can diverge sharply from Ceneo's
  - Lower data quality: mixed-variant spec tables, AI-written descriptions, raw German feed titles
  - No API, MCP or legitimate automation; terms forbid scraping
  - Nokaut is gone (closed Dec 2024 / Jan 2025), so the PL comparison market is effectively Ceneo plus Skapiec

**independent review consensus**

No independent hands-on test of either engine was found. Secondary sources agree on the market structure: Ceneo dominant, Skapiec second, Nokaut closed (Tabletowo 20 Dec 2024; seigi.eu 2025, a vendor blog; Bezprawnik 1 Jul 2026). Picodi (8 Apr 2026, a coupon and cashback publisher, affiliate-adjacent) describes Skapiec's open price history. Antyweb (May 2020, editorial, outdated) describes Skapiec's delivery-cost comparison and scale. No sponsored Skapiec coverage was identified among the sources opened.

**verdict for me**

PILOT for Skapiec; SKIP for Nokaut (closed). Deciding fact: Skapiec showed marketplace offers (Kaufland, Allegro, Amazon.pl) and a PLN 180 cheaper price than Ceneo for the same trampoline, and offers 1-year history without login. Best use: after the Ceneo sweep, open the same model on Skapiec, sort by price (ignore 'Promowana oferta'), read the 1-year history, and record both offer tables side by side in the vault's _raw area.

**conflicting evidence**

- Skapiec scale: Antyweb (2020) about 11 million products and 3,100 shops; Polish Wikipedia 6 million products and 13,000+ shops; Skapiec /o-nas 'thousands of shops, millions of products' (no figures).
- Skapiec history ranges: Picodi (Apr 2026) lists 14 days, 30 days, 3, 6 and 12 months; the live product page on 2026-10-15 showed 14d, 3m, 6m and 1r only.
- Skapiec delivery costs: Antyweb (2020) says Skapiec compares purchase terms including delivery costs; the product page checked on 2026-10-15 showed shipping badges but no delivery prices.
- Shop ratings: Media Expert 2.1/5 (14,741 reviews) on Opineo/Skapiec vs 4.7/5 (3,430) on Ceneo; ELECTRO.pl 4.0/5 (74,322) on Opineo vs 1.5/5 (22) on Ceneo (both seen 2026-10-15).

- Nokaut owner: Sales Intelligence per the closure statement; SARE (now Digitree Group) agreed to buy Sales Intelligence from HubStyle, and the redirect to media.digitree.pl suggests the deal closed, but no primary confirmation was found.

### Allegro buyer tools

**Verdict:** USE NOW · **Cost:** Free; Smart! 59.90 PLN a year · **Verified:** 2026-10-15 · 10 field(s) flagged ⚠

#### identity

**basics**

Allegro.pl, the largest Polish online marketplace, assessed here as a bundle of free buyer-side tools: (1) product catalogue with parameter filters and a side-by-side parameter comparison page (allegro.pl/porownanie, 'Dodaj do porownania'); (2) offer grouping by catalogue product/EAN ('Ten produkt od innych sprzedajacych (N)' with cheapest new, cheapest outlet and fastest delivery); (3) Allegro Smart! subscription (free delivery and one free return per order); (4) Allegro Ochrona Kupujacych buyer protection (called 'Allegro Protect' from Nov 2022 to Aug 2025); (5) seller signals ('poleca X%', Super Sprzedawca, 'Oficjalny sklep', 'Autoryzowany sklep marki', 'Firma'); (6) purchase-verified product reviews; (7) the Omnibus field 'cena z 30 dni' (lowest price of that offer in the 30 days before a discount); (8) the 'Gwarancja najnizszej ceny' badge and 'Oszczedzasz X zl kupujac na Allegro' claim; (9) price-drop notifications for watched offers. There is no buyer-facing price-history chart. Role type: marketplace with built-in comparison and price-claim features.

**⚠ vendor and ownership**

Operator of allegro.pl: Allegro sp. z o.o., ul. Wierzbiecice 1B, 61-569 Poznan, KRS 0000635012. Parent: Allegro.eu S.A., based in Luxembourg and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange. It also runs allegro.cz, allegro.sk and allegro.hu, and owns Ceneo.pl. Scale (vendor-claimed, Q1 2026 press release): 20.4 million active buyers in the region (15.5 million in Poland), over 80 million products from 150,000+ merchants. Where bias can enter: Allegro earns from seller commissions, ads (Allegro Ads), Allegro Pay (16.1% of Q1 2026 GMV) and Allegro Delivery, and it runs its own retail. UOKiK fined it in 2022 for favouring that own store (self-preferencing). ⚠ *(unverified)* Current shareholder structure after the 2024-2025 private-equity sell-downs was not verified.

**lifecycle status**

Launched and mature (founded 1999; the press release says 'founded in Poland 25 years ago'). Changes in the last 12 months: Allegro Protect renamed back to 'Allegro Ochrona Kupujacych' on 2025-08-18 with rules unchanged (Antyweb 2025-07-30, Tabletowo 2025-07-31). Terms changes on 2026-02-16: Allegro Family ended; 'highest rating' sorting now weights how recent reviews are and the positive/negative ratio (CHIP 2026-01-30). Smart! free-delivery threshold unified to 49.90 zl for subscriptions activated from 2026-03-02 (Allegro help page). Current Regulamin Allegro effective 2026-10-13. Verified on 2026-10-15 on allegro.pl help pages, the Regulamin and live listings (primary).

**cost model**

Free to browse, compare and buy. Allegro Smart!: 59.90 PLN per year or 14.99 PLN per month (Allegro help page 'Jak kupic usluge Allegro Smart!', seen 2026-10-15). Free trial: 5 free deliveries and returns within 3 months; it requires marketing consent and a phone number not used for a trial before. Promotional prices exist, e.g. 39.90 PLN per year for selected users until 2026-06-12 (Tabletowo). Without Smart, a typical trampoline offer charged 14.99 PLN delivery on 2026-10-15 (e.g. 349.99 PLN item, 364.98 PLN with delivery); one bulky offer charged 170 PLN (880.99 PLN item, 1,050.99 PLN with delivery). Buyer protection and the lowest-price-guarantee coupon cost nothing.

**⚠ feature geo matrix**

- **Poland**: All features available on allegro.pl in Polish: catalogue, filters, comparison page, Smart! (free delivery only within Poland, up to 10 courier addresses), Ochrona Kupujacych, 'cena z 30 dni', lowest-price guarantee, watched-offer notifications. Verified live 2026-10-15.
- **EU**: Sister sites allegro.cz, allegro.sk and allegro.hu have their own Smart! (1.3 million users outside Poland, Q1 2026 press release) and buyer protection under local names ('Allegro bezpecny nakup', 'Allegro Vasarlovedelem'). allegro.pl offers a 'Dostawa za granice' filter (Ukraine, Czechia, Hungary, Slovakia and 20 more countries). ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether the lowest-price guarantee and watched-offer alerts exist on the CZ/SK/HU sites was not checked.
- **US**: N/A. Allegro does not serve the US market.
- **language**: Polish interface. Help pages have a 'CHANGE LANGUAGE' switch. Offers can be in other languages; a Slovak-titled offer appeared in Polish search results on 2026-10-15.
- **agentic or US only features**: No agentic checkout, buy-for-me or target-price alerts for buyers. Allegro Pay spending budgets (daily and monthly limits) were announced in Jan 2026.

#### capabilities

**spec and variant comparison**

Partial. Offers are linked to catalogue products with EAN (seen 2026-10-15: Urbogym 10ft EAN 5904906085350; Thunder 10ft EAN 5904161751526) and structured parameters. For trampolines these are size in ft (e.g. '10 (304-312 cm)'), max load, total height, shape, number of springs, number of poles, net type and child age. Category filters use these parameters: 689 of 727 offers in the '305' search are 10 ft. 'Dodaj do porownania' plus allegro.pl/porownanie shows a parameter table (the page says it lists product parameters to show how they differ). 'Dostepne warianty' switches sizes and colours, and 'Pokaz warianty od innych sprzedajacych' switches sellers. Limits: parameters are entered by sellers, and nonsense values appeared live, e.g. a SONGMICS 10 ft trampoline with 'Maks. obciazenie 1 kg', a Polgar 305 cm one with 'Wysokosc calkowita 2.4 cm', and Bestway with size 'inny (257)'. Buyers can report wrong catalogue links ('Zglos oferte blednie powiazana z produktem'). Nothing maps white-label rebadges: near-identical 10 ft frames sold under Polish importer brands (Neo-Sport, Funfit, Urbogym, HyperMotion, Thunder, Rebel, 4FIZJO) are separate catalogue products. There are no structured fields for frame steel thickness, galvanisation or the EN 71-14 edition.

**price comparison and pl coverage**

Inside Allegro only. Same-product offers from other sellers are grouped ('Ten produkt od innych sprzedajacych (16)' on Urbogym 10ft, cheapest new 499 PLN, outlet 299 PLN), and results can be sorted by 'cena z dostawa'. Allegro does not show prices from other shops. The external benchmark is only the 'Gwarancja najnizszej ceny' badge: Allegro says it compares daily against a list of shops. The panel seen 2026-10-15 named amazon.pl, empik.com, mediaexpert.pl, euro.com.pl, oponeo.pl, decathlon.pl, doz.pl, leroymerlin.pl, zalando.pl and smyk.com, with a full list in the terms. 'Oszczedzasz X zl kupujac na Allegro' is attached to that program and shows no reference shop or price. Not covered: Ceneo shop offers, brand stores, Amazon.de and idealo shops. Trampoline inventory (2026-10-15): 9,820 offers in the category and 727 for 'trampolina ogrodowa 305'. Coverage counts are measured; savings claims are vendor-claimed.

**⚠ price history and omnibus**

No price-history chart for buyers. None appeared on offer pages on 2026-10-15, and Allegro community threads ask for one; Allegro moderators point to Allegro Analytics, a paid seller tool. Omnibus: when an offer is discounted, Allegro automatically shows that offer's lowest price from the 30 days before the reduction, and the seller cannot set it (moderator statements). Seen live: '-5% 455,05 zl cena z 30 dni' next to 432.29 PLN, and '-9% 329,00 zl cena z 30 dni' next to 299 PLN. Limits: the value is per offer, not per product across sellers, and offers not marked as discounted show no reference. It cannot reveal a seller who raised the base price in the past 30+ days. ⚠ *(unverified)* UOKiK reportedly questioned that the 30-day price appeared only after the user expanded a message, and older forum posts say it was not visible in the mobile app; the dates and current state are unconfirmed. Watched-offer 'potanialo' notifications fire on any decrease, including a seller undoing a temporary increase, and may omit the previous price (forum).

**total landed cost**

Partial. Listings show 'cena z dostawa' (item plus cheapest delivery) and can be sorted by it. Smart! makes delivery free when one seller's items total 49.90 PLN or more (subscriptions from 2026-03-02; older ones 45 PLN lockers, 65 PLN courier), the offer carries the Smart! badge, and that seller's delivery cost per shipment is under 100 PLN. Smart! also gives one free return per order. Offer pages state the return window (seen: 'Zwrot - 30 dni', 'Zwrot za darmo - 14 dni'). Installment price ('x 5 rat', 'zaplac pozniej') is shown. Not computed: assembly, the return shipping cost of a 40-60 kg parcel when the free return does not apply, return costs for the 307 trampoline offers shipped from China, or how enforceable a cross-border warranty is.

**⚠ review and seller verification**

Partial. Product reviews: only buyers can review (purchase-verified, per Allegro and press); offer pages show 'Wszystkie opinie sa potwierdzone zakupem' and disclose removed reviews ('1 usunieta'). Reviews belong to the catalogue product, so every offer linked to it shows the same pool; the 4FIZJO 10ft and a generic 'TRAMPOLINA DOMOWA' listing both showed 855 ratings. Seller signals: 'poleca X%' (seen 99.4% Urbogym official shop, 99.1% sellBEST, 83.3% E-Fitness), the Super Sprzedawca badge, account type (Firma, Oficjalny sklep, Autoryzowany sklep marki), seller name and BDO number. ⚠ *(unverified)* Super Sprzedawca criteria found are from 2023: company account, 'Super' sales quality on at least 14 of the last 30 days, at least 50 orders in 30 days. The public API seller-rating structure changes on 2026-11-02 (developer.allegro.pl news). Not done: no KRS/CEIDG/VAT white-list/VIES check is shown to the buyer, and no review-authenticity analysis is shown. Allegro forum users report reviews written repeatedly by the same accounts (unverified). Cannot prove: reviewer independence, incentivised reviews, or whether a catalogue entry merges different physical products.

**safety and compliance checks**

Partial (display only). Each offer has a GPSR panel 'Odpowiedzialnosc za produkt' (manufacturer name, country, address, email, phone, EU responsible person) and 'Bezpieczenstwo, zgodnosc i ostrzezenia' (seller-uploaded files, e.g. 'Informacje o bezpieczenstwie_1.pdf'). Seen 2026-10-15: Urbogym 10ft, manufacturer and EU responsible person Urbogym sp. z o.o., Warsaw; Thunder 10ft, manufacturer SELLBEST sp. z o.o., Krasnik (a retailer that also sells treadmills, dehumidifiers, mowers and window robots under its own series); a China-shipped 1.6 m trampoline, manufacturer Ningbo Wanhe Home Technology Co., Ltd (China), EU responsible person VAT SPEED SL, Madrid. Not done: no Safety Gate or UOKiK register cross-check, no structured EN 71-14:2018 vs 2025 field, no certificate verification (Certipedia). All of these must be done manually or by an agent reading the GPSR panel and PDF.

**independent test coverage**

N/A as a tool feature. Allegro does not surface Stiftung Warentest, VKI, Which? or CHOICE results. Listing pages carry Allegro's own editorial content ('Ekspert doradza: Jakie sa rodzaje trampolin', 'Testowalem rozne modele i te 5 trampolin spelnily moje...', 'Najlepsze trampoliny ogrodowe ranking pazdziernik 2026') and a 'Top 10' ranking 'generated once a day' from ratings and recent purchases. These are not independent lab tests.

**⚠ alerts and monitoring**

Basic. Watched offers ('Obserwowane'): Allegro sends email and app push notifications when a watched offer's price drops. You cannot set a target price, notifications may omit the previous price, and they fire on bounce-back reductions (Allegro community threads). Search follow ('Polub wyszukiwanie') exists. ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether a followed search sends new-offer alerts was not confirmed. Event-driven, no polling frequency stated. Cannot watch non-Allegro shop pages.

**purchase automation and guardrails**

No automation for buyers. Purchases are made manually ('Kup i zaplac' or the cart). The REST API exposes order data and is seller-oriented; there is no buyer checkout endpoint. Merchant of record is the individual seller; Allegro is the intermediary. Payment options include BLIK, card, transfer and Allegro Pay; Allegro Pay spending budgets with daily and monthly limits were announced in Jan 2026 (CHIP) and can serve as a hard cap. AI-assisted ordering (ChatGPT app 'Kup na Allegro') is covered in the separate item.

**after sales and resale**

Partial. The 'Trampoliny i akcesoria' category lists spare nets, spring pads and springs, but availability for a given brand depends on sellers. Offer pages link 'Reklamacja' (complaint form) and 'Gwarancja' (warranty terms). Statutory warranty (rekojmia) runs against the seller. Resale and used: condition filters (nowe 9,588, jak nowe 175, uzywane 42, uszkodzone 15 in the trampoline category), outlet offers (Urbogym 10ft outlet 299 PLN vs 499 PLN new), and Allegro Lokalnie classifieds, which Ochrona Kupujacych also covers. No resale-value data.

#### data and integration

**data sources and freshness**

First-party marketplace data: seller-entered offers (title, parameters, price, stock, delivery), Allegro's product catalogue (EAN, parameters, pooled reviews), live prices and stock. Lowest-price-guarantee comparisons run daily (Allegro). The Top-10 ranking is generated once a day (on-page note). 'X osob kupilo ostatnio' counts are live. No LLM in core listings. Every offer has a stable URL and an offer number; product pages carry the EAN in the page title.

**api mcp skill access**

Partial. (1) Official REST API (developer.allegro.pl): OAuth2 device flow for a personal account, plus client_credentials app tokens. Public offer search GET /offers/listing has been restricted to verified applications since 2021-06-01. New apps get 403 until Allegro verifies them through a contact form, with no self-service; a 2023 GitHub discussion (allegro/allegro-api #4584) shows it is still restricted. The sandbox needs no verification. The API terms require a registered User-Agent. (2) No official Allegro MCP server found. Community MCP servers, all unofficial, 0-4 stars, checked 2026-10-15: Bilski311/allegro-mcp (Kotlin, MIT; buyer account: orders, watched offers, bought items; last push 2025-12-30); stepek/allegro-mcp (Rust, MIT; tools generated at runtime from the official OpenAPI schema, device/PKCE/client_credentials, read-only mode; last push 2026-09-10); Zziembie/allegro-mcp-server (Python, MIT; seller-side tools; last push 2026-10-11); andrewsakhno/allegro-mcp-searcher (Python, no licence; offer search via /offers/listing, so it needs a verified app; last push 2026-07-30). (3) Browser agent: the Claude built-in browser read listing, product, GPSR, help and terms pages normally on 2026-10-15, while plain HTTP fetches (WebFetch) got 403. (4) No Claude skill or CLI exists. Setup effort: browser route in minutes; buyer-account MCP in about 1 hour (register an app, run device flow); public search through the API needs Allegro's verification (timeline unknown).

**protocol support**

None of ACP, UCP, AP2, Visa TAP or Klarna APP for buyers on allegro.pl. Allegro is not on Shopify, so Shopify catalog MCP/UCP does not reach it. Its only agent-commerce surface is the ChatGPT app built on OpenAI's Apps SDK (MCP-based), covered in the separate item.

**open source and licence**

Closed (proprietary marketplace). The official API is documented publicly (OpenAPI swagger at developer.allegro.pl/swagger.yaml), and issues are tracked in github.com/allegro/allegro-api. Community MCP wrappers listed above are MIT-licensed.

**account linking and data access**

Browsing needs no account. Buying needs an Allegro account with email, phone and delivery address. The Smart! trial requires marketing consent and a phone number. Personalised recommendations depend on a personalisation consent; without it the recommender shows bestsellers, and withdrawing consent removes those factors (Regulamin art. 23.4-23.5). From 2026-02-16 Allegro may use email and phone plus AI to personalise ads, and ThreatMetrix for fraud checks in financial services (CHIP summary of the terms change). Controller: Allegro sp. z o.o. GDPR applies; no payment credentials need to be shared with third-party tools.

**⚠ automation legal risk**

High for scraping, low for personal manual or browser-agent use. Regulamin Allegro (effective 2026-10-13), art. 10.10: downloading or using Allegro materials, data included, requires Allegro's consent each time. It prohibits aggregating and processing Allegro data for further use in business activity, 'including extraction (scraping) of this data, in particular with bots and other IT tools'. Art. 10.11 bans bots that generate increased traffic or overload systems. Observed on 2026-10-15: plain HTTP clients received 403 from allegro.pl and allegro.pl/smart, while a real browser worked. ⚠ *(unverified)* The DataDome attribution comes from scraper-vendor reports (outline note), not from Allegro. Account sanctions are possible under the terms. The compliant route is the official API under its terms.

#### trust and bias

**monetization and bias vector**

Seller commissions, Allegro Ads, Allegro Pay (BNPL), Allegro Delivery and Smart! subscriptions. Paid placements are labelled: in the 'trampolina ogrodowa 305' search on 2026-10-15 (default sort, logged out), the first 16 result tiles were all paid placements (9 'Sponsorowane', 7 'Promowane'), and so were 24 of the first 26. 'Sponsorowane' carousels also appear in 'Odkryj podobne produkty' and 'Propozycje dla Ciebie' on product pages (e.g. Neo-sport, Jumpi). Clicking a sponsored tile adds tracking parameters (bi_s=ads). The default sort ('Trafnosc Ofertowa') counts 'use of the paid promotion option' and the 'Gwarancja najnizszej ceny' badge as ranking factors (Regulamin art. 3.4), so paid promotion and Allegro's own badge raise organic rank too. Allegro's self-preferencing of its own store was fined by UOKiK in 2022. Smart! and Allegro Delivery steering is under UOKiK investigation (2025-2026).

**ranking transparency**

Partial. Regulamin art. 3.4 discloses the default-sort factors: terms compliance, views, purchases, cart adds, favourites, price, number of free-delivery methods, expected delivery time, item condition, Buy Now vs auction, offer duration, paid promotion, lowest-price-guarantee badge, category fit, and title similarity to the query. Weights are not disclosed, and AI tools may shift factor priorities 'depending on campaigns, seasonality, promotions' (art. 23.5). Sponsored items are labelled 'Sponsorowane' or 'Promowane'. Users can re-sort (price, price with delivery, popularity, rating, newest) but cannot exclude Allegro's own signals.

**run to run consistency**

N/A. Core listings are not generative AI. The default sort is personalised and behaviour-driven, and sponsored slots rotate, so repeat searches can order results differently. Sorting by price is deterministic.

**manipulation and injection resistance**

Not applicable to prompt injection in the core marketplace. Seller-controlled content is the main manipulation surface: titles stuffed with keywords ('BEZPIECZNA', 'PREMIUM', 'XXL'), wrong parameters (seen live), and pooled catalogue reviews. Safeguards: purchase-verified reviews, removed-review disclosure, seller sales-quality levels, sanctions for terms violations, and buyer protection as a fallback. The AI Q&A on offer pages ('Zapytaj o ten produkt', Beta) reads listing content, so it is exposed to seller-written text. Allegro warns that the AI 'may be wrong'.

**known failures**

(1) Wrong or nonsense seller parameters in the trampoline category (seen 2026-10-15: 'Maks. obciazenie 1 kg', 'Wysokosc calkowita 2.4 cm'). (2) Machine-translated cross-border listings, e.g. 'nogi w ksztalcie litery U', and a Slovak-titled offer in Polish results. (3) The Omnibus reference shows only on discounted offers, per offer. (4) Watched-offer 'price dropped' notifications after a temporary increase (forum). (5) Ochrona Kupujacych refusals: a 2026 forum case (robot mower, 5,746 PLN) was refused because the purchase used a company invoice (NIP), so the buyer was treated as a non-consumer; it was unresolved in Sept 2026 (one-sided account). (6) Users call the lowest-price guarantee 'worthless' in a community thread; the badge covers only a list of shops and excludes promotions at those shops. (7) UOKiK probes into steering of delivery-method choice (2025-2026).

**⚠ regulatory enforcement history**

UOKiK, Dec 2022: about PLN 206 million for abusing a dominant position through self-preferencing of Allegro's own store, plus PLN 3.97 million for abusive clauses in the Allegro Smart! terms, more than PLN 210 million in total. Allegro appealed. ⚠ *(unverified)* The appeal outcome was not verified. UOKiK, 27 May 2025: explanatory proceeding over reports that parcels addressed to InPost lockers were redirected to Allegro Delivery points. UOKiK, 26 Feb 2026: court-authorised search of Allegro offices in Poznan and Warsaw over possible favouring of its own delivery methods; the investigation is 'in the matter', not yet against Allegro. Erli has filed a lawsuit alleging abuse of dominance. ⚠ *(unverified)* UOKiK's review of how 40 online retailers, Allegro included, display the 30-day lowest price has no confirmed date or outcome. No DSA or DMA decision against Allegro was found.

**⚠ buyer protection path**

Allegro Ochrona Kupujacych (help page, read 2026-10-15). It covers Allegro and Allegro Lokalnie purchases, up to 20,000 PLN, when the parcel did not arrive or items were missing, the seller did not refund after a cancellation or return, or the item was damaged or not as described and the seller did not resolve the complaint. You can apply from day 14 to 2 years after purchase, or 7 days after reporting non-delivery. Decisions usually take 2-3 business days (Smart!: priority, 2 business days); payout usually follows in 3-7 business days to the card or account used. Compensation is 'not always 100%'. Exclusions: purchases outside Allegro, cash on personal pickup, suspended accounts, compensation already received from another source. ⚠ *(unverified)* 2024 rules: no compensation for orders paid entirely with vouchers; carrier loss or damage goes to the carrier; a 40,000 PLN per-2-years cap, later clarified as per seller; current status unverified. Merchant of record: the seller. Statutory rights apply against the seller: rekojmia (2 years) and 14-day withdrawal for consumers. Buying on a company invoice (NIP) can cost consumer status (forum case above). Sellers shipping from China (307 trampoline offers) are harder to pursue; for EU sellers the ECC route applies. Lowest-price guarantee: report a cheaper listed shop within 72 h of purchase; review within 21 days; coupon worth up to 150% of the difference, valid 12 months (on-page panel, 2026-10-15).

#### fit for user

**⚠ fit for big ticket durables**

Good for discovery and purchase, weak for quality judgement. Trampoline category on 2026-10-15: 9,820 offers. By shipping origin: Poland 8,393 (85.5%), Czechia 311, China 307 (3.1%), other EU 237, Slovakia 50, Hungary 7, Allegro warehouse 2. Offers branded 'bez marki' (no brand): 1,834 (18.7%), including all 307 China-shipped offers. Search 'trampolina ogrodowa 305': 727 offers, 716 shipped from Poland. Most top-selling 10 ft offers come from Polish importer brands (Urbogym, Neo-Sport, Funfit, HyperMotion, Thunder/sellBEST, Rebel, 4FIZJO, Zipro). Their GPSR panels name the Polish company as 'Producent' and do not disclose the factory. ⚠ *(unverified)* So 'shipped from Poland' does not mean EU-made, and the white-label share is an inference that the live data does not prove. Premium brands are rare (one BERG Ultim Favorit 410 at 4,279 PLN; AXI; Domyos 300 at 1,199 PLN). Typical 10 ft with net: 350-700 PLN, range 320-1,355 PLN. What it does well: filter by size, net type, max load and shipping origin; compare parameters; see pooled reviews; read GPSR data; buy under protection. What it cannot do: verify EN 71-14 compliance, frame quality or Safety Gate hits, show price history, or compare with Decathlon, brand shops or Amazon.de.

**workflow role**

Discovery, specs and variants, price within Allegro, partial seller check, purchase, after-sales (complaint, buyer protection). Combine with: Ceneo or idealo for cross-shop price; a price-history tool (AlleRadar extension or own snapshots); Safety Gate/UOKiK and certificate checks from the GPSR data; independent tests; and EU brand stores for premium models.

**⚠ effort and cost per purchase**

Manual: free, about 30-60 min to filter, open 5-10 offers, read GPSR panels and reviews. Smart! (59.90 PLN per year) beats paying 14.99 PLN per delivery after 4 deliveries in a year; for one trampoline only the trial or a monthly 14.99 PLN plan makes sense. Agent route (Claude built-in browser): one listing plus 5 product pages, the GPSR panels and the comparison page is about 8-12 page reads. ⚠ *(unverified)* That is roughly 60-120k input tokens, so cost depends on the model (well under USD 1 on a mid-tier model). No proxy or scraping API is needed when an agent drives the user's real browser. The official API is free but public search needs Allegro's app verification.

**evidence trail**

Good raw material, no export. Each offer has a stable URL, an offer number, the EAN in the product page title, the seller name and rating, price, delivery price, 'cena z 30 dni' when discounted, and GPSR manufacturer and EU responsible-person text. Allegro does not export these; Regulamin art. 10.8 tells users to archive transaction information themselves. A vault record would hold: date and time, offer URL and number, EAN, seller and 'poleca %', price and price with delivery, the 30-day reference if shown, GPSR manufacturer and EU responsible person, review count and average, plus screenshots of the offer and GPSR panel.

#### assessment

**strengths weaknesses**

- **strengths**:
  - Largest Polish inventory with structured trampoline parameters and a parameter comparison page (9,820 trampoline offers on 2026-10-15).
  - Offer grouping by EAN/catalogue product shows the cheapest new, outlet and fastest offer for the same product.
  - GPSR manufacturer and EU responsible-person panel on every offer, plus shipping-origin filter (including 307 China-shipped offers) for seller-origin screening.
  - Allegro Ochrona Kupujacych up to 20,000 PLN for 2 years, on top of statutory rights against the seller.
  - Ranking factors are disclosed in the terms, and paid placements are labelled 'Sponsorowane' or 'Promowane'.
- **weaknesses**:
  - No price history; the Omnibus 'cena z 30 dni' appears only on discounted offers and is per offer.
  - 'Gwarancja najnizszej ceny' and 'Oszczedzasz X zl' claims compare against a limited shop list without showing the reference price, and they also boost ranking.
  - Seller-entered parameters are sometimes wrong, and white-label OEM rebadges are not linked, so 'choosing the best version' still needs manual work.
  - Reviews are pooled per catalogue product, so they may describe another seller or batch; authenticity is not analysed.
  - Scraping is banned by the terms and plain HTTP gets 403; the public search API needs Allegro verification.

**independent review consensus**

No independent hands-on evaluation of Allegro's buyer tools as a set was found. Independent evidence comes from regulators (UOKiK 2022 decisions, 2025-2026 investigations) and news coverage of terms changes (Antyweb, Tabletowo, CHIP, Bankier). The CHIP item on the terms is editorial; some CHIP Allegro pieces are labelled 'Lokowanie produktu: Allegro' (paid placement). User reports on the Allegro community forum are mixed: buyer protection works in many cases, but refusals happen and lowest-price-guarantee coupons are criticised. These are anecdotes, not systematic data.

**verdict for me**

USE NOW: Allegro has the largest Polish trampoline inventory (9,820 offers) with GPSR manufacturer data, EAN grouping and buyer protection up to 20,000 PLN. Best use: shortlist and buy on Allegro as a consumer (not on a NIP invoice), after checking price history, safety registers and cross-shop prices elsewhere. Drive it from Claude Code through the built-in browser, not by scraping.

**conflicting evidence**

- Smart! annual price: 59.90 PLN (Allegro help page, 2026-10-15; Tabletowo) vs 59.99 PLN (Picodi 2026 report). The primary source wins: 59.90 PLN.
- Smart! free-delivery threshold: 49.90 PLN for subscriptions activated from 2026-03-02 vs the legacy 45 PLN (lockers) and 65 PLN (courier) still valid for older subscriptions (both on the Allegro help page). Secondary sources present 49.90 PLN as universal.
- Ochrona Kupujacych aggregate cap: 40,000 PLN per buyer over 2 years (Feb 2024 announcement) vs per seller (later Allegro clarification reported by press). The current help page states only the 20,000 PLN per-claim maximum.
- Omnibus display: Allegro moderators say the struck-through price is the lowest 30-day price and is shown automatically, vs users and a UOKiK review reporting that it was visible only after expanding a message and not in the app (older threads, date unclear).
- Super Sprzedawca criteria: the 2021 article (100 ratings, 4.950 average, 20 orders) vs Sept 2023 rules (Super quality 14 of 30 days, 50 orders). Neither confirmed for 2026.

### Allegro AI Assistant and ChatGPT app

**Verdict:** WATCH · **Cost:** Free · **Verified:** 2026-10-15 · 7 field(s) flagged ⚠

#### identity

**basics**

Allegro's conversational shopping tools. (1) 'Asystent AI' in the Allegro mobile app: chat-style, needs-based product search over Allegro offers. It answers follow-ups, explains differences and compares parameters, and shows results as category tiles. You open it from a star icon in the search bar. (2) The 'Allegro' app inside ChatGPT, built on OpenAI's Apps SDK. You call it with '@Allegro' or pick it from connected apps. It searches Allegro offers in real time and returns cards (photo, price, rating, units sold, short description) with 'Kup na Allegro' and 'Przejdz do Allegro' buttons. Its predecessor was the custom GPT 'Allegro GPT' (beta, Dec 2025). Related but separate: an AI Q&A box 'Zapytaj o ten produkt' (Beta) on offer pages, seen on desktop on 2026-10-15, and a desktop and mobile-web shopping-assistant pilot with Google (Q1 2026 press release). Role type: AI shopping assistant tied to one marketplace.

**⚠ vendor and ownership**

Allegro sp. z o.o. (Poznan), part of Allegro.eu S.A. (Luxembourg, listed on the WSE). Allegro announced a strategic partnership with OpenAI on 2026-05-11: access to OpenAI's latest models and to OpenAI experts for designing, testing and deploying AI for e-commerce. Commercial terms were not disclosed. Allegro also runs a pilot with Google for a web shopping assistant (Q1 2026 press release). ⚠ *(unverified)* Which LLM powers the in-app Asystent AI is not disclosed. Bias note: the assistant searches only Allegro's own inventory, and Allegro earns from those sales and from ads.

**lifecycle status**

In-app Asystent AI: Allegro announced it on 2025-10-30 and said a test version was live (Antyweb 2025-10-30; Spider's Web 2025-10-31). Beta for selected users started in Nov 2025 (Spider's Web 2025-11-04); CHIP on 2025-12-03 reported random users on app versions iOS 8.47.0 and Android 9.47.0. It reached all mobile-app users in early May 2026 (Wiadomosci Handlowe 2026-05-07; Spider's Web, BiznesRadar and instalki 2026-05-08). The Q1 2026 press release says it is 'now live after well-received tests'. Allegro GPT (custom GPT, beta) launched 2025-12-04. The OpenAI partnership was announced 2026-05-11. The Allegro app in ChatGPT went live on 2026-05-11 or 2026-05-12; Spider's Web calls it the 'final version', while an Allegro moderator on 2026-05-17 said the integration was 'in an early phase'. Allegro launched a seller-side AI assistant on 2026-04-29. Desktop: on 2026-10-15 allegro.pl desktop (logged out) showed only 'wyszukiwanie wielu przedmiotow' (multi-item search) and image search in the search bar, with no chat assistant. The offer-page AI Q&A was marked 'Beta'. Verified 2026-10-15. Most hands-on sources are 4-11 months old, and no hands-on test from after June 2026 was found.

**cost model**

Free. The ChatGPT app works with a free OpenAI account; no paid ChatGPT plan or Allegro Smart! is needed (android.com.pl 2026-05-12; android.com.pl 2025-12-04 for Allegro GPT). Allegro is paid through the purchases and ads that follow.

**⚠ feature geo matrix**

- **Poland**: In-app Asystent AI: available to all Allegro mobile-app users since May 2026, in Polish. ChatGPT app: used from Poland with Polish queries in several hands-on tests (May 2026), so it works for Polish ChatGPT users. Offer-page AI Q&A (Beta): seen on desktop on 2026-10-15.
- **EU**: ⚠ *(unverified)* Availability on allegro.cz, allegro.sk and allegro.hu not confirmed. OpenAI launched ChatGPT apps outside the EU in Oct 2025 and promised EU later; no official OpenAI EU-rollout note was found, but Polish users have demonstrably used the Allegro app since May 2026.
- **US**: N/A. Allegro does not serve the US.
- **desktop**: In-app assistant: mobile app only. Desktop 'later' (Antyweb 2025-10-30); no entry point visible on 2026-10-15. Google-backed web assistant: a 'pilot' per the Q1 2026 press release, not observed. ChatGPT app: works in ChatGPT web and mobile.
- **agentic checkout price alerts buy for me**: None. Payment always happens on Allegro. No price alerts. Building a cart and assembling an order from one seller are planned features (May 2026).

#### capabilities

**spec and variant comparison**

Vendor-claimed: it compares parameters and matches products to needs. Allegro data reported by Antyweb (2026-05-08): almost 35% of Home & Garden conversations contained concrete numbers or dimensions, and half of Electronics conversations were compatibility checks ('czy pasuje do', 'zamiennik'). Hands-on: Spider's Web (2026-05-08) asked for a timing-belt kit using only car make and model, and the assistant listed engine variants so the right kit could be chosen. android.com.pl (2026-05-27) got short explanations, e.g. quartz vs automatic watches, but no side-by-side spec table. ChatGPT app (Tabletowo hands-on, 2026-05-12): a long smartphone query returned one Motorola. Asking for at least 3 models gave 'Nie znaleziono ofert', then the same Motorola, then a plain list of 4 models without offer links. No evidence that it maps EAN equivalents or white-label rebadges across brands.

**price comparison and pl coverage**

Allegro only, by design. It does not compare against other shops. ChatGPT app: an Allegro moderator confirmed on 2026-05-17 that ChatGPT sometimes gives priority to its global shopping module instead of the Allegro app. Results then mix non-Allegro sources (a user got Reddit links and no Allegro offers), with sources shown as 'Allegro +N'. Workaround: '@allegro znajdz [item] tylko na Allegro' or the Allegro GPT Beta model. Price finding: android.com.pl (2026-05-12) asked for the cheapest 1 kg Lavazza Crema Classico and got 74.26 PLN; a manual check in another tab found nothing better. The author warned the model 'may skip a good offer'. 'Finding the most attractive offers' is a planned feature (May 2026).

**price history and omnibus**

None. Neither tool shows price history, the Omnibus 30-day lowest price or fake-discount flags in any source reviewed. Cards show the current price, rating and units sold.

**total landed cost**

No. Cards show the item price. Allegro says filtering considers Allegro Smart! benefits (Antyweb 2026-05-12). Allegro GPT failed to build a cart that qualified for Smart! free delivery (Antyweb hands-on 2025-12-04). Assembling an order from one seller to reach the free-delivery threshold is planned. Shipping, return costs and assembly are not computed.

**review and seller verification**

None to minimal. Cards show the product rating and units sold. No seller-identity check, seller-rating filter or review-authenticity analysis is reported.

**safety and compliance checks**

None. No Safety Gate, UOKiK, GPSR or EN 71-14 checks are reported. The offer-page AI Q&A answers from listing data and carries the disclaimer that the AI 'may be wrong, verify answers'.

**independent test coverage**

N/A. It does not surface independent lab tests. It may answer from general knowledge; Allegro says the assistant uses Allegro data plus general knowledge.

**alerts and monitoring**

None. No price, restock or change alerts in either tool.

**purchase automation and guardrails**

Cannot pay. In-app: hands off to the normal Allegro checkout. ChatGPT app: 'Kup na Allegro' opens Allegro's payment-and-delivery form with the product already added; 'Przejdz do Allegro' opens the product page; payment happens on Allegro (android.com.pl, Antyweb, Tabletowo, May 2026). No ChatGPT Instant Checkout or ACP. It cannot assemble a multi-product cart; each product opens in a separate tab (Tabletowo 2026-05-12). Human confirmation is built in because the user completes checkout on Allegro. Merchant of record: the Allegro seller.

**after sales and resale**

Not covered.

#### data and integration

**data sources and freshness**

Vendor-claimed: real-time access to Allegro's offers, prices, stock and promotions ('millions of offers'). The ChatGPT app calls Allegro through an app connector. Reported lags and failures: 'blad podczas rozmawiania z domena connector' and 'Allegro API connection has temporary problems' (Allegro GPT, Tabletowo 2025-12-04); 'Nie znaleziono ofert' while offers existed (Tabletowo 2026-05-12). Answers are usually backed by offer cards with links, but sometimes come as plain lists without links, prices or photos.

**⚠ api mcp skill access**

None. No public API for the in-app assistant. The ChatGPT app runs on OpenAI's MCP-based Apps SDK, but ⚠ *(unverified)* no public MCP endpoint, documentation or terms for third-party clients were found, so Claude Code cannot call it. From Claude Code: drive allegro.pl with a browser agent, or use the REST API and community MCP servers (see item 'Allegro (marketplace buyer tools)'). Grade: none.

**protocol support**

OpenAI Apps SDK (built on MCP) for the ChatGPT app, with OAuth account linking. No ACP or Instant Checkout, UCP, AP2, Visa TAP or Klarna APP. Interoperability is limited to ChatGPT.

**open source and licence**

Closed.

**⚠ account linking and data access**

In-app: Allegro account login. ChatGPT app: in ChatGPT go to Apps, Allegro, 'Polacz', grant the requested permissions, 'Przejdz do Allegro', then log in to Allegro (OAuth). If the browser is already logged in to Allegro, linking completes automatically. The consent screen includes an optional tick 'Pamieci i czaty do wykorzystania', which lets the app use ChatGPT memory and earlier chats. Disconnect via Settings, Apps, Rozlacz (android.com.pl 2026-05-12). Data: queries and linked-account context are shared between OpenAI and Allegro. ⚠ *(unverified)* No app-specific privacy notice or data-sharing scope from Allegro was found; one tester was uneasy about sharing purchase data with OpenAI. No payment credentials are given to ChatGPT. GDPR: Allegro and OpenAI each appear to control their own processing. Whether ChatGPT memory has EU-specific limits that affect this app was not verified here.

**automation legal risk**

Low for personal use of the official tools. Nothing permits scripting or scraping the assistant's output; Allegro's general terms (art. 10.10-10.11) ban scraping and bots.

#### trust and bias

**⚠ monetization and bias vector**

It searches only Allegro inventory, so it never says another shop is cheaper. Allegro says results weigh product popularity and Allegro Smart! benefits (Antyweb 2026-05-12). ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether sponsored or promoted offers are boosted inside assistant answers is not disclosed. In the ChatGPT app, OpenAI's own shopping module can override the app. Several launch articles are paid or partner content: CHIP 2025-12 and 2026-05 are labelled 'Lokowanie produktu: Allegro', and Bezprawnik 2026-06-25 was written 'we wspolpracy z Allegro.pl'.

**ranking transparency**

Low. Users can ask the assistant to justify picks (Allegro's Grzeskowiak: buyers ask follow-ups and request justifications). No ranking criteria or source list is published, and you cannot exclude sources. When ChatGPT blends sources it shows 'Allegro +N'.

**⚠ run to run consistency**

⚠ *(unverified)* No systematic repeat test was published. Anecdotally, in Tabletowo (2026-05-12) the same need, rephrased, gave one product, then 'no offers found', then a link-less list, which points to unstable output.

**manipulation and injection resistance**

No published tests. Seller-written titles and descriptions feed the LLM and are a plausible prompt-injection and persuasion vector. ChatGPT's global shopping module can pull in non-Allegro web content. Allegro publishes no safeguards beyond 'AI may be wrong' disclaimers.

**known failures**

(1) Allegro GPT (Dec 2025): repeated 'connector domain' errors and no results for queries that had offers (Tabletowo 2025-12-04); could not build a Smart! free-delivery cart (Antyweb 2025-12-04). (2) ChatGPT app (May 2026): one product for a broad query, 'Nie znaleziono ofert', plain lists without links or prices, no full-cart assembly (Tabletowo 2026-05-12); answers with no Allegro offers and links to Reddit and other sites, confirmed by an Allegro moderator as an integration issue (Allegro community, 2026-05-16/17); may skip good offers (android.com.pl 2026-05-12). (3) In-app assistant: sometimes replies that it lacks the competence or is not programmed for an action; a 'BETA' label still showed in screenshots after GA (android.com.pl 2026-05-27).

**regulatory enforcement history**

N/A for these specific tools; no decision found. Allegro's general record (UOKiK 2022 self-preferencing fine, 2025-2026 delivery probes) is in the 'Allegro (marketplace buyer tools)' item.

**buyer protection path**

Same as any Allegro purchase, because checkout happens on Allegro: the seller is merchant of record, Allegro Ochrona Kupujacych applies (up to 20,000 PLN, 2 years), and statutory rekojmia and 14-day withdrawal apply against the seller. OpenAI and ChatGPT are not a party to the sale. An AI recommendation error is not a protected event; only seller non-performance is.

#### fit for user

**fit for big ticket durables**

Moderate for discovery, weak for the decision. For a trampoline you can state the need in Polish, e.g. 'trampolina ogrodowa ok. 3 m z siatka wewnetrzna, dwoje dzieci, do 150 kg, do 600 zl'. It turns that into Allegro filters and a shortlist, can explain inner vs outer net or 10 ft vs 12 ft, and fits Home & Garden, the category behind about 34% of assistant-generated GMV (Allegro data via Antyweb). It cannot verify EN 71-14 compliance, frame quality or Safety Gate status, see non-Allegro shops (Decathlon, brand stores, Amazon.de), track price history or compute total cost. The ChatGPT app may drop to one product or to non-Allegro sources.

**workflow role**

Discovery, and turning needs into specs, within Allegro only. Combine with: Allegro listing filters and the GPSR panel for verification; cross-shop comparison (Ceneo, idealo); price history; safety registers and independent tests.

**effort and cost per purchase**

Free. In-app: zero setup, a few minutes per conversation. ChatGPT app: one-time account linking of about 2 minutes, then seconds per query, but every result needs a manual check on allegro.pl (about 5-15 min per shortlist). No API credits or proxies involved.

**⚠ evidence trail**

Weak. ChatGPT keeps the conversation with cards and links in the user's chat history. ⚠ *(unverified)* Whether in-app assistant chats are stored and viewable later is not documented. There are no price snapshots or timestamps per card; for a vault note, copy offer URLs, offer numbers, prices and the date manually, or screenshot the cards.

#### assessment

**strengths weaknesses**

- **strengths**:
  - Needs-based Polish-language search: turns vague needs into Allegro offers, with good examples for car parts and compatibility questions.
  - Free, no paid ChatGPT plan or Smart! required; the ChatGPT app works for Polish users from May 2026.
  - Purchase stays on Allegro, so normal checkout confirmation and Allegro buyer protection apply; ChatGPT never gets payment data.
  - Allegro reports heavy use in Home & Garden (about 34% of assistant GMV), the trampoline category.
- **weaknesses**:
  - Allegro-only inventory, so it is not a neutral price finder and may skip better offers even within Allegro.
  - Documented failures in the ChatGPT app (May 2026): single results, 'no offers found', link-less lists, non-Allegro and Reddit sources.
  - No price history, Omnibus check, total-cost, seller or safety verification.
  - Cannot be driven from Claude Code: no public API or MCP endpoint.
  - Sources are 4-11 months old and partly sponsored; usage figures are vendor-claimed and worded inconsistently.

**independent review consensus**

Hands-on (editorial, unsponsored unless noted): Tabletowo 2025-12-04 (Allegro GPT unusable, connector errors) and 2026-05-12 (ChatGPT app unconvincing, unstable results). Antyweb 2025-12-04: part-search works well, the free-delivery cart failed. android.com.pl 2026-05-12: coffee test succeeded, verify everything. android.com.pl 2026-05-27: in-app assistant useful for gift ideas and inspiration, still learning. Spider's Web 2026-05-08: car-part variant help. Sponsored or partner pieces: CHIP 2025-12-03 and 2026-05-14 ('Lokowanie produktu: Allegro', 'never failed me'); Bezprawnik 2026-06-25 (written with Allegro). Consensus: helpful for vague needs and inspiration, unreliable for exhaustive or cheapest-price search; the ChatGPT app was buggy at launch. No independent test after June 2026 was found.

**verdict for me**

WATCH: it cannot be driven from Claude Code and only searches Allegro, and the ChatGPT app had documented empty and off-Allegro results in May 2026. Best use: ask the in-app assistant to translate the trampoline needs into Allegro parameters and a 3-5 offer shortlist, then verify each offer's GPSR panel, reviews and price elsewhere.

**conflicting evidence**

- 600k figure: 'over 600 thousand people made purchases with the Assistant's help' (Wiadomosci Handlowe 2026-05-07 headline; BiznesRadar 2026-05-08) vs 'over 600 thousand active users' or 'used by' (Antyweb, Spider's Web, instalki, CHIP 2026-05-08/14) vs '600,000 people tested it' (android.com.pl 2026-05-20). The press release behind them was not found, so treat it as about 600k test-phase users, purchase share unknown.
- Pilot start: the outline says the pilot began Dec 2025, but the sources show the in-app assistant test was announced 2025-10-30 and ran with selected users from Nov 2025; Dec 2025 is when Allegro GPT (the ChatGPT custom GPT) launched.
- ChatGPT app launch date: same day as the partnership announcement, 2026-05-11 (an unnamed outlet in a search-result summary, page not opened; Antyweb on 2026-05-12 says the partnership was announced 'yesterday' and the app launched 'today') vs the day after the announcement, 2026-05-12 (xyz.pl via search summary; Spider's Web 2026-05-12). The partnership date 2026-05-11 (a Monday) is consistent across sources.
- Maturity of the ChatGPT app: 'final version' replacing the beta (Spider's Web 2026-05-12) vs 'integration in an early phase' with the old Allegro GPT Beta model 'working better' (Allegro moderator, 2026-05-17).
- Desktop availability: the Q1 2026 press release says Allegro 'launched a shopping assistant on desktops and mobile web as part of a pilot with Google' vs no assistant entry point on allegro.pl desktop (logged out) on 2026-10-15 and 'desktop later' (Antyweb 2025-10-30).
- EU availability of ChatGPT apps: OpenAI's Oct 2025 launch excluded the EU with 'EU soon' and no dated EU rollout was found, vs several Polish hands-on tests of the Allegro app in May 2026.
